Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Lokales Gruben-und-Samen-Säen
sowing_local.descTemplate: Wo Säspiele in {country} Wurzeln schlugen, zeigen Bretter von {civ} eigene Napfzahlen, Staffelregeln und Holzformen. Sie gehören zur Mancala-Familie, verdienen aber regionale Einträge, wenn Brettgeometrie und Fangsitten lokal standardisiert sind.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Napfbretter oder Gruben in der Erde

jump_rope.title: Seilspring-Spiele
jump_rope.descTemplate: Springseil-Reime gedeihen in Schulhöfen und Straßen von {country} in der Kindheitskultur von {civ}. Solo-Schnellschritte und Gruppen-Langseil teilen den Hüpf-Rhythmus; Singsprüche lokalisieren das Spielzeug.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: Blindekuh / Rufspiele
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Spiele mit verbundenen Augen—Ruf-und-Ausweich-Varianten—erscheinen bei Festen und Kindertreffen von {civ} in {country}. Klang, Stillstehen und Empathie für den geblendeten Spieler strukturieren den Spaß.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Volkstümliches Jugendringen
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Jugend-Ringkampfspiele bereiten auf Erwachsenen-Volksstile vor, die Gemeinschaften von {civ} in {country} feiern. Spielversionen betonen sichere Würfe, Kreisgrenzen und Lachen statt Verletzung—Sport als soziales Spielzeug.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Gedächtnislied / Ausscheide-Singspruch
memory_song.descTemplate: Ausscheide-Singsprüche und Gedächtnislieder—ähnlich Kreis-Spielen „wer bleibt“—sind Rhythmus- und Aufmerksamkeits-Spielzeuge in der mündlichen Kultur von {civ} in {country}. Falsche Worte oder verpasste Schläge scheiden aus, bis einer bleibt.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Stelzen oder Balance-Stangen
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stelzen erscheinen als Festwerkzeuge und Kinder-Balance-Spielzeuge in {country}. Macher von {civ} erheben Geher auf Bambus, Holz oder recycelten Dosen. Rennen und Trickschritte machen Höhe zum Spiel.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: Blatt- oder Rindenboot-Rennen
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Miniatur-Boot-Rennen mit Blättern, Rinde oder Maiskolben erfreuen Kinder am Wasser in {country}. Spiel von {civ} macht Strömungen zu Bahnen und Handwerk zu Ingenieur-Experimenten.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Blätter, Rinde oder Kork für Rümpfe

snow_or_sand.title: Sand-/Schneefiguren-Spiel
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Temporäre Figuren in Sand oder Schnee zu formen ist elementares Konstruktionsspiel, wo Landschaften von {civ} in {country} das Medium bieten. Burgen, Tiere und Ahnenformen erscheinen und erodieren—Architektur als flüchtiges Spielzeug.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Tisch-Flickfußball / Papierfußball
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flickspiele, die Fußball auf dem Tisch simulieren, verbreiteten sich in Schulen in {country}, auf älteren Finger-Flick-Spielgewohnheiten in der Kindheit von {civ}. Tore sind Bücher oder gezeichnete Pfosten; Turniere können heftig sein.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Lokaler Rätselaustausch
riddle_local.descTemplate: Rätselaustausch in {country} bewahrt Metapher, Ökologie und Humor von {civ}. Stellen und Lösen unter Zeitdruck ist ein Denksportzeug ohne Fabrikgerät.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Festlärm-Spielzeug
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Festlärmer—Ratsche, Klapper, Glockenstäbe—lassen Kinder öffentliche Riten von {civ} in {country} mitmachen. Lautstärke und Rhythmus markieren Kalenderzeit; manche Spielzeuge sind saisonal und danach wie Ritualgerät verstaut.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.

puzzle_knot.title: Schnur-und-Knoten-Rätselspielzeug
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Entwirrungsrätsel aus Schnur, Ringen und Holz erscheinen als Marktspielzeuge und Schmiede-Kuriositäten um {country}. Spieler von {civ} lernen Topologie durch Tasten—einen Ring lösen ohne Zwang, dann wieder zusammensetzen.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Miniatur-Haushalts-Spielset
mini_house.descTemplate: Winzige Haushaltsgeräte—Tonpfannen, gewebte Matten, Puppenmöbel—stützen Rollenspiel erwachsenen Hauslebens in Kindheiten von {civ} in {country}. Archäologie und Ethnographie finden diese Lehrspielzeuge.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: 婴儿响铃
rattle.descTemplate: 老鼠是最古老的音效玩具之一. 在{country},{civ}的照顾者长期将种子或卵石封在瓜、粘土、篮子或木材中,以奖励婴儿的抓住和节奏。 响尾蛇既是感官玩具,在有些地方也是保护魅力的声音（{country}，{civ}）
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: 用种子、卵石或铃声响起
rattle.participants: 独自一人(有照料者的婴儿)

whistle_toy.title: 克莱或木哨玩具
whistle_toy.descTemplate: 小型哨子——鸟形粘土、木雕、芦苇——出现在{country}与{civ}生活相连的市场和考古层。 儿童使用它们作为声音复制玩具;有些是节日噪声制作人的双倍. 音响游戏教气息和音响游戏（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: 动物牵引玩具
pull_toy.descTemplate: 轮式动物和拉长的人物通过{country}中的乡村木制工艺从古典古典的记载. {civ}工匠塑造马,鸟,或牛,教徒步幼儿运动时的牵引和陪伴.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: 轮式或滑动的动物体型

mini_weapons_toy.title: 玩具弓或飞镖游戏集
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: 缩放的狩猎玩具让参加{country}的儿童用更安全的材料排练由{civ}成人庆祝的技能——箭术、长矛角镖或吹管瞄准器。 目标在稻草,木头上,或者仍处于画圈中,把武术变成打分游戏.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: 口袋技艺石头
jacks_local.descTemplate: {country}除了共有的关节家族之外,还有由{civ}童年时期塑造的本地石质和种子技能序列——不同的投掷、高呼和困难阶梯,它们都以同样的皮卡原则为基础,记录下来,当高呼和顺序是当地特有的时,作为区域实践条目。
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: 故事数/ 抽签游戏
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: 在{country}的集会中,出现了为转弯、没收或故事提示而投放土地的情况。 无论是竹棍、棍棒、骰子, ({civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.
req: 标记的棍子,很多,或者骰子

shadow_play.title: 暗影人物游戏
shadow_play.descTemplate: 影子游戏——手动动物或皮木偶——在{country}故事中夜里娱乐。 光线和光线将手势变成戏剧 一些地区将此提升为正式的傀儡艺术;儿童的手影仍然是玩具形式（{country}，{civ}）
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: 当地风筝工艺
kite_local.descTemplate: 虽然风筝飞行是一个全球大家庭,但{country}的{civ}制造者开发了独特的形状、纸张、绞盘和节日用途。 本条目突出介绍当地工艺传统,在更广泛的风筝天空下作为区域风筝练习 ({civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: 本地布娃娃
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: 穿着当地纺织图案的软娃娃在{country}全家出现. 刺绣,包衣,发型都小化成人服饰. 照料游戏传授社会角色;手工艺技巧世代相传。 ({civ})
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: 缝布或藏球
ball_sewn.descTemplate: 在工业橡胶之前,{country}中的{civ}社区从藏物、布或植物纤维上塞入和缝合球。 捕捉,踢,和圆形游戏 围绕这些物体。 球的制作与规则一样文化化 ({civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: 本地旋转顶部工艺
top_local.descTemplate: 本条目记录了{country}的{civ}雕刻风格、小费材料和竞技礼仪,作为共享物理玩具中一种独特的工艺技巧和游戏练习。
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: 本地字符串数字
string_local.descTemplate: 与{country}相关的{civ}弦图 携带着当地的名字,动物和神话,即使开口像猫的摇篮在别处. 数字是可移植的故事图和手记忆图 ({civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: 民俗比赛委员会(地方)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: 交叉圈和路径赛板出现在很多土地上. 在{country}G中,{civ}的玩家使用贝壳,棍棒或关节骨来进行家乡的赛车标记——cousins用于类似帕奇西的结构,但当地的赛道形状和安全空间风俗记录为地区民间赛车委员会（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: 当地的坑种子播种
sowing_local.descTemplate: 在播种游戏扎根于{country}的地方,{civ}板上显示有特色的杯数,接力规则和木质形状. 它们属于Mancala家族,但在当地标准化的棋盘几何和捕捉习俗时,它们理应成为区域条目。
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: 跳过绳子游戏
jump_rope.descTemplate: 在{country}的校园和{civ}童年文化的街道中,跳跃和跳跃的韵律蓬勃发展。 独奏速度步和组长绳游戏分享弹跳节奏;高呼玩具本地化（{country}，{civ}）
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: 盲人标签/呼叫游戏
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: 在{civ}聚会和儿童聚会上出现。 声音,静态,和同情 盲目玩家结构的乐趣（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: 青少年摔跤比赛
wrestling_play.descTemplate: 青年摔跤比赛为{civ}社区在{country}庆祝的成人民间风格做准备. 游戏版本强调安全抛球,圈圈界限,以及嘲笑伤害——体育作为社会玩具.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: 记忆歌曲/ 消除高呼
memory_song.descTemplate: 在{country}的口腔文化中, 错误的字句或错过的节拍将玩家消灭,直到有一个人留下（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: 平板或平衡杆
balance_stilts.descTemplate: 在{country}中,Stilts作为节日工具和儿童平衡玩具出现. {civ}厂商在竹子,木材或回收罐上饲养行尸. 赛跑和诡计 将高地变成游戏（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: 树叶或树皮船赛
leaf_boat.descTemplate: 迷你船用ẳ梨树叶、树皮或玉米棒在{country}附近游玩, {civ}游戏将电流变成轨道,而工艺则变成工程实验（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: 树叶、树皮或船体的软木

snow_or_sand.title: 沙子/ 积雪人物游戏
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: 在沙或雪中雕刻临时人物是元素构造游戏,只要{country}的景观提供了介质。 城堡、动物和祖传形态出现并如何能够被侵蚀——建筑是麻风玩具（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: 表闪足球/纸球
knuckle_football.descTemplate: 在{country}的学校里, 目标为书本或标卿职位楷模;锦标赛会很激烈 ({civ})
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: 本地谜题交换
riddle_local.descTemplate: {country}的中枢交流保留了{civ}的比喻,生态学和幽默. 在时间压力下使用和解决是不需要制造设备的思维玩具。 ({civ})
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: 节日噪音制造玩具
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: 节日的噪音制作者——剪刀、拍手、钟棒——让儿童参加{civ}的{country}公共仪式帘。 音量和节奏标记日历时间;一些玩具是季节性的,在之后 doctoratey,就像仪式用具一样储存（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.

puzzle_knot.title: Cord 拼图玩具( T)
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: 绳子、戒指和木头的分离谜题作为{country}周围的市场玩具和铁匠奇才出现。 {civ}玩家通过触摸来学习地形学——不强迫地释放一个戒指,然后重新组装（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: 小型家庭游戏
mini_house.descTemplate: 小型家庭工具——桶、编织的垫子、娃娃家具——支持{civ}在{country}的童年中成人家庭生活的角色扮演。 考古学和人种学都发现了这些教学玩具.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: 幼蟲響
rattle.descTemplate: 老鼠是最古老的音效玩具之一 在{country}中,{civ}的照料者長期封存种子或卵石,用古德、黏土、籃子或木頭來獎勵嬰兒的抓住和節奏。 響響是感官玩具 在某些地方是保護性的魅力 ({civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Hollow rattle with seeds, pebbles, or bells
rattle.participants: 獨自一人(有照料者的孩子)

whistle_toy.title: Clay 苟且是木哨玩具
whistle_toy.descTemplate: 小哨子——鳥形黏土、木雕、苇子——出現在市場和與{civ}生活相關的考古地區。 有些是節日噪音制造者, 音效演奏教人呼吸和投球（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: 動物拉玩具
pull_toy.descTemplate: Wheeled animals and pull-along figures are documented from classical antiquity through village woodcrafts in {country}. {civ} artisans shape horses, birds, or oxen that teach walking toddlers about traction and companionship in motion.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: 旋轉或滑動的動物身材

mini_weapons_toy.title: 玩具弓或飛镖遊戲設定
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: 使用更安全的材料, 稻草、木頭或圈子上的目標 把武術變成打分（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: 口袋技術石
jacks_local.descTemplate: Beyond the shared knucklebones family, {country} has local stone-and-seed skill sequences shaped by {civ} childhood—different throws, chants, and difficulty ladders on the same pickup principle, recorded here as a regional practice entry when chants and sequences are locally distinct.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: 故事數量/ 抽签遊戲
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: 在{country}的聚會上出現了轉折、失業或故事提示。 不管是竹棍、指骨或骰子,（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: 影象播放
shadow_play.descTemplate: 影劇「手動動物或皮木偶」, 燈光和光線把手勢變成戲劇 有些地區將這提升為正式的木偶藝術;（{country}，{civ}）
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: 本地風筝技術
kite_local.descTemplate: {country}的{civ}製作人發展出獨特的形狀、紙、 bri和節日用法。 這項項項目突出了當地技術傳統, ({civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: 本地布娃娃
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: 在{country}, 裝飾 包裝 髮型 小型化成人服裝 關注遊戲教人社會角色,（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: 衣服或藏球
ball_sewn.descTemplate: 在工業橡皮之前,{country}的{civ}群落, 抓住 踢 圍繞著這些物件的圓圈遊戲 球的制作和規矩一樣文化 ({civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: 本地旋轉的頂端手術
top_local.descTemplate: Top play is ancient and global; this entry records {country}'s {civ} carving styles, tip materials, and contest etiquette as a distinct craft-and-play practice within that shared physics toy.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: 本地字串數字
string_local.descTemplate: {civ}與{country}相關的字串數字, 數字是可移植的故事圖和手記憶圖。
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: 民俗比賽(地方)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: 跨圈和路徑賽車板出現在許多土地. 在{country}, {civ}的玩家使用彈殼、棍棒或指骨來比賽,（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: 本地的土豆栽培
sowing_local.descTemplate: 在ZZCOUNTRY ZHZ中播種遊戲, 他們屬於曼卡拉家族,（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: 跳過繩子遊戲
jump_rope.descTemplate: 在{country}的學院和街道上, 單曲速度步調與群組長曲游戲分享跳動的節奏;（{country}，{civ}）
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: 大麻、塑料或葡萄藤的绳索

blindfold_tag.title: 盲人標籤/呼叫遊戲
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: 在{civ}的派對上, 聲音 靜靜 同情 盲目 Olympiaable 的玩家（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: 青少年摔跤
wrestling_play.descTemplate: 年輕的摔跤比賽, 遊戲版本强调安全投球、圓圈邊界,（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: 記憶歌曲/ 消除高音
memory_song.descTemplate: 在{civ}的口語文化中, 錯誤的字眼或錯誤的打擊使玩家消失所掌握的,直到留下一個（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: 平面或平衡柱
balance_stilts.descTemplate: 在{country}, {civ}製造商在竹子、木頭或回收罐上養活行尸。 跑步和耍花招 把高處變成游戲（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: 樹葉或樹皮賽艇
leaf_boat.descTemplate: 迷你船在{country}裡用樹葉、樹皮或玉米棒 取悅靠近水的孩子們 {civ} 游戲把水流變成軌道 和工業實驗
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: 樹葉、樹皮或船身的軟木

snow_or_sand.descTemplate: 在沙子或雪中雕刻临时人物, 城堡、動物、祖傳形式都出現,（{country}，{civ}）

riddle_local.descTemplate: 在{country}的中間交流 保留特别是那些比喻、生态和幽默 在時間壓力下發揮和解答 需要的问题上不需要正在开展的設備 ({civ})

ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: 讓孩子加入{civ}的公祭。 有些玩具是季节性的,（{country}，{civ}）

puzzle_knot.descTemplate: 在{country}附近, {civ}玩家學習地形學用触摸法——不強硬釋放戒指,然后重新組裝.

mini_house.title: 小型家庭遊戲集
mini_house.descTemplate: 在{country}的童年, 考古學靓女學家都找到了這些教書的玩具（{country}，{civ}）
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.

Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.

Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: शिशु
rattle.descTemplate: Rattles सबसे पुराना ध्वनि खिलौने के बीच हैं। {country} में, {civ} देखभाल करने वालों में लंबे समय तक सील किए गए बीज या कंकड़ों में गोर्ड, मिट्टी, टोकरी, या लकड़ी में शिशु की चर्बी और लय को पुरस्कृत करने के लिए होते हैं। खड़कना दोनों संवेदी खिलौना है और कुछ स्थानों में एक सुरक्षात्मक आकर्षण ध्वनि है।

Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.

req: बीज, कंकड़ या घंटी के साथ खोखले खड़खड़

whistle_toy.title: क्ले या लकड़ी सीटी खिलौना
whistle_toy.descTemplate: छोटी सीटी - पक्षी के आकार की मिट्टी, नक्काशीदार लकड़ी, रीड- बाजार में प्रकट होती है और पुरातात्विक परतों को {civ} जीवन से जुड़ा हुआ है। बच्चे उन्हें ध्वनि-amplifying खिलौने के रूप में उपयोग करते हैं; कुछ त्योहारों के रूप में डबल। ध्वनि नाटक सांस और पिच को खेलने के लिए सिखाता है।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: पशु पुल खिलौना
pull_toy.descTemplate: पहिएदार जानवर और पुल-अलोंग आंकड़े को {country} में गांव के वुडक्राफ्ट के माध्यम से शास्त्रीय प्राचीनता से प्रलेखित किया जाता है। {civ} कारीगरों को घोड़े, पक्षियों या बैलों को आकार देते हैं जो गति में कर्षण और साथीता के बारे में पैदल चलने वालों को सिखाते हैं।
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: खिलौना धनुष या डार्ट प्ले सेट
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: स्केलेड शिकार खिलौने बच्चों को {country} रीहर्स कौशल में बच्चों को ZZ वयस्कों द्वारा मनाया जाता है - आर्करी, स्पीयर-थर्न डार्ट्स, या ब्लोपाइप लक्ष्य - सुरक्षित सामग्री का उपयोग करना। स्ट्रॉ, वुड या ड्रॉ सर्कल पर टारगेट्स ने मार्शल तकनीक को स्कोर्ड प्ले में बदल दिया। ({civ})
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: नरम या कम शक्ति खिलौना धनुष / डार्ट

jacks_local.title: पॉकेट कौशल पत्थर
jacks_local.descTemplate: साझा knucklebones परिवार से परे, {country} में स्थानीय पत्थर-और-बीज कौशल अनुक्रम हैं, जो {civ} बचपन से अलग-अलग फेंकता है, चकंट और उसी पिकअप सिद्धांत पर कठिनाई सीढ़ी, यहां एक क्षेत्रीय अभ्यास प्रविष्टि के रूप में दर्ज किया गया है जब चकंट और अनुक्रम स्थानीय रूप से अलग होते हैं।
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: कहानी बहुत सारे / ड्राइंग बहुत सारे खेल
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: बदल जाता है के लिए बहुत कास्टिंग, forfeits, या कहानी संकेत {country} में {civ} सम्मेलनों में दिखाई देते हैं। चाहे बांस की छड़ें, knucklebones, या चित्रित पासा, संभावना चुनती है कि कौन बोलता है, नृत्य करता है, या जवाब देता है - विभाजन और पार्टी के खेल के किनारे पर एक सामाजिक खिलौना।
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: छाया आंकड़े प्ले
shadow_play.descTemplate: छाया नाटक-हाथ जानवरों या चमड़े के कठपुतली - {civ} कहानी कहने के भीतर {country} में मनोरंजक रात है। लाइट और सिल्हूट थिएटर में इशारा करते हैं। कुछ क्षेत्रों ने इसे औपचारिक कठपुतली कला में बढ़ाया; बच्चों की हाथ की छाया खिलौना रूप बनी हुई है।
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: स्थानीय पतंग शिल्प
kite_local.descTemplate: जबकि पतंग उड़ान एक वैश्विक परिवार है, {country} के {civ} निर्माताओं ने विशिष्ट आकार, कागजात, चूड़ी और त्योहार का उपयोग किया। इस प्रविष्टि में दर्शाया गया है कि स्थानीय शिल्प परंपरा को व्यापक पतंग आकाश के तहत क्षेत्रीय पतंग अभ्यास के रूप में।
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: स्थानीय कपड़ा गुड़िया
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: स्थानीय वस्त्र पैटर्न में तैयार शीतल गुड़िया {civ} परिवारों में {country} में दिखाई देती है। कढ़ाई, लपेटें कपड़े, और केश विन्यास वयस्क पोशाक को छोटा करते हैं। देखभाल करने का नाटक सामाजिक भूमिकाओं को सिखाता है; शिल्प तकनीक पीढ़ियों के बीच गुजरती है।
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Sewn कपड़ा या छुपा गेंद
ball_sewn.descTemplate: औद्योगिक रबर से पहले, {country} में {civ} समुदायों को छिपाने, कपड़े या संयंत्र फाइबर से भरवां और सिलवाया गया। कैच, किक और सर्कल गेम इन वस्तुओं के आसपास बढ़े। गेंद बनाने के नियम के रूप में सांस्कृतिक है।
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Sewn कपड़ा, हथेली, या छुपा गेंद

top_local.title: स्थानीय कताई शीर्ष शिल्प
top_local.descTemplate: शीर्ष खेल प्राचीन और वैश्विक है; इस प्रविष्टि रिकॉर्ड {country} की {civ} नक्काशी शैली, टिप सामग्री, और प्रतियोगिता शिष्टाचार कि साझा भौतिकी खिलौना के भीतर एक अलग शिल्प और खेल अभ्यास के रूप में।
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: स्थानीय स्ट्रिंग आंकड़े
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} स्ट्रिंग आंकड़े {country} से जुड़े स्थानीय नामों, जानवरों और मिथकों को ले जाते हैं, यहां तक कि जब उद्घाटन किसी अन्य जगह बिल्ली के पालने जैसा दिखता है। आंकड़े कहानी और हाथ स्मृति के पोर्टेबल आरेख हैं।
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: लोक रेस बोर्ड (स्थानीय)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: क्रॉस-एंड-सर्कल और पथ रेस बोर्ड कई क्षेत्रों में दिखाई देते हैं। {country} में, {civ} खिलाड़ियों ने दौड़ मार्करों के घर के लिए गोले, छड़ें या knucklebones का इस्तेमाल किया, लेकिन स्थानीय ट्रैक आकृतियों और सुरक्षित-स्पेस रीति-रिवाजों के साथ क्षेत्रीय लोक रेस बोर्ड के रूप में दर्ज किया गया।
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: स्थानीय पिट-एंड-सीड सोइंग
sowing_local.descTemplate: जहां बुवाई के खेल ने {country} में जड़ ली, {civ} बोर्ड विशिष्ट कप गिनती, रिले नियम और लकड़ी के आकार दिखाते हैं। वे मन्केला परिवार से संबंधित हैं, फिर भी क्षेत्रीय प्रविष्टियों के हकदार हैं जब बोर्ड ज्यामिति और कैप्चर सीमा शुल्क स्थानीय रूप से मानकीकृत होते हैं।
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: पृथ्वी में कप बोर्ड या गड्ढे

jump_rope.title: रस्सी खेल
jump_rope.descTemplate: {civ} बचपन की संस्कृति के भीतर {country} के स्कूलयार्ड्स और सड़कों में कूदने और कूदने वाली रस्सी कविताएं कामयाब हुई। एकल गति कदम और समूह लंबे समय तक खेल bouncing लय साझा करते हैं; chants खिलौना स्थानीयकरण।
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: भांग, प्लास्टिक, या बेल की रस्सी

blindfold_tag.title: ब्लाइंड मैन का टैग / कॉल गेम
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: ब्लाइंडफोल्डेड की तलाश में गेम-कॉल-एंड-डेज वेरिएंट- {civ} पार्टियों और {country} में बच्चों के सम्मेलनों में दिखाई देते हैं। ध्वनि, स्थिरता, और अंधा खिलाड़ी संरचना के लिए सहानुभूति मज़ा।
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: युवाओं के लिए लोक कुश्ती खेल
wrestling_play.descTemplate: युवा कुश्ती खेल {country} में {civ} समुदायों द्वारा मनाया वयस्क लोक शैलियों के लिए तैयार है। प्ले संस्करण सुरक्षित थ्रो, सर्कल सीमाओं पर जोर देते हैं, और चोट पर हत्या करते हैं - सामाजिक खिलौना के रूप में खेलते हैं।
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: मेमोरी गीत / उन्मूलन चांट
memory_song.descTemplate: एलिमिनेशन chants और स्मृति गीत - 'who बनी हुई' सर्कल गेम के लिए - जेडसीसीआईवीजेड मौखिक संस्कृति में लय और ध्यान के खिलौने हैं। गलत शब्दों या मिस्ड बीट्स खिलाड़ियों को तब तक समाप्त कर देते हैं जब तक कि एक बनी रहती है।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Stilts या संतुलन ध्रुव
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts त्योहार उपकरण और बच्चों के संतुलन खिलौने {country} में के रूप में दिखाई देते हैं। {civ} निर्माता बांस, लकड़ी, या पुनर्नवीनीकरण डिब्बे पर वॉकर उठाते हैं। रेसिंग और चाल कदम बारी ऊंचाई खेलने में।
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: स्टिल्ट्स या टिन-कैन स्टिल्ट्स की जोड़ी

leaf_boat.title: हार्वर्ड कैम्पस
leaf_boat.descTemplate: पत्तियों, छाल या कॉर्नकोबों का उपयोग करके लघु नाव दौड़ बच्चों को {country} में पानी के पास प्रसन्न करती है। जेडजेडसीआईवीजेड प्ले इंजीनियरिंग प्रयोगों में ट्रैक और शिल्प में धाराओं को बदल देता है। ({civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: पत्तियों, छाल, या hulls के लिए कॉर्क

snow_or_sand.title: सैंड / स्नो फिगर प्ले
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: रेत या बर्फ में अस्थायी आंकड़े मूर्तिकला उन मौलिक निर्माण नाटकों में से एक है जहां {country} में {civ} परिदृश्य माध्यम प्रदान करते हैं। महल, जानवर, और ancestral रूपों दिखाई देते हैं और erode-architecture ephemeral खिलौना के रूप में।
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: टेबल फ़्लिक फुटबॉल / पेपर सॉकर
knuckle_football.descTemplate: झिलमिला खेल जो {country} में स्कूलों के माध्यम से टेबलटॉप स्प्रेड पर फुटबॉल / सॉकर का अनुकरण करते हैं, जो {civ} बचपन में पुरानी उंगली-फ्लिकिंग खिलौना आदतों पर आधारित है। गोल किताबें या ड्रॉ पोस्ट हैं; टूर्नामेंट भयंकर हो सकता है।

riddle_local.title: स्थानीय पहेली विनिमय
riddle_local.descTemplate: {country} में पहेली आदान-प्रदान {civ} metaphor, पारिस्थितिकी और हास्य को संरक्षित करता है। समय के दबाव में डालने और हल करने के लिए एक मन खिलौना है जिसे कोई निर्मित उपकरण की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

ceremonial_toy.title: महोत्सव शोरमेकर खिलौना
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: फेस्टिवल शोरमेकर्स-रैचेट, क्लैपर्स, बेल-स्टिक्स-लेट बच्चे {country} में {civ} सार्वजनिक संस्कारों में शामिल हो जाते हैं। वॉल्यूम और लय मार्क कैलेंडर समय; कुछ खिलौने मौसमी हैं और बाद में अनुष्ठान गियर की तरह संग्रहीत हैं।
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.

Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.

puzzle_knot.title: कॉर्ड और गाँठ पहेली खिलौना
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: कॉर्ड, रिंग्स और लकड़ी के विघटन की पहेली बाजार के खिलौने और ब्लैकस्मिथ करियोसिटीज़ के रूप में दिखाई देती है। {civ} खिलाड़ी टच द्वारा टोपोलॉजी सीखते हैं - फोर्सेस के बिना एक रिंग जारी करते हैं, फिर इकट्ठा होते हैं।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: लघु घरेलू खेल सेट
mini_house.descTemplate: छोटे घरेलू उपकरण-कैले पैन, बुना मैट, गुड़िया फर्नीचर-ZZ बचपन में वयस्क घरेलू जीवन की भूमिका-खेल का समर्थन करते हैं। पुरातत्व और नृविज्ञान दोनों इन शिक्षण खिलौनों को पाते हैं।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: ماشية صغيرة
rattle.descTemplate: الماشية من أقدم ألعاب الصوت In {country}, {civ} caregivers have long sealed seeds or pebbles in gourd, clay, basketry, or wood to reward infant grasping and rhythm. الغرابة هي لعبة حسية وفي بعض الأماكن صوت سحر واق.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.

Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.

whistle_toy.title: (كلاي) أو صافرة الخشب
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Small whistles—bird-shaped clay, carved wood, reed—appear in markets and archaeological layers tied to {civ} life in {country}. Children use them as voice-amplifying toys; some double as festival noisemakers. Sound play teaches breath and pitch playfully.

Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: لعبة سحب الحيوانات
pull_toy.descTemplate: Wheeled animals and pull-along figures are documented from classical antiquity through village woodcrafts in {country}. {civ} artisans shape horses, birds, or oxen that teach walking toddlers about traction and companionship in motion.

Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).

mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Scaled hunting toys let children in {country} rehearse skills celebrated by {civ} adults—archery, spear-thorn darts, or blowpipe aim—using safer materials. Targets on straw, wood, or drawn circles turn martial technique into scored play.

Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.

Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.

jacks_local.title: حجارة مهارات الطلاء
jacks_local.descTemplate: Beyond the shared knucklebones family, {country} has local stone-and-seed skill sequences shaped by {civ} childhood—different throws, chants, and difficulty ladders on the same pickup principle, recorded here as a regional practice entry when chants and sequences are locally distinct.

First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: / لعبة سحب
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Casting lots for turns, forfeits, or story prompts appears in {civ} gatherings in {country}. Whether bamboo sticks, knucklebones, or painted dice, chance chooses who speaks, dances, or answers—a social toy at the edge of divination and party game.

Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: أرقام الظلال
shadow_play.descTemplate: Shadow play—hand animals or leather puppets—has entertained nights in {country} within {civ} storytelling. Light and silhouette turn gesture into theater. Some regions elevated this into formal puppet arts; children's hand shadows remain the toy form.

Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.

kite_local.title: مركبة محلية من الطرود
kite_local.descTemplate: While kite flying is one global family, {country}'s {civ} makers developed distinctive shapes, papers, bridles, and festival uses. This entry highlights that local craft tradition as a regional kite practice under the wider kite sky.

Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: دمية القماش المحلية
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Soft dolls dressed in local textile patterns appear across {civ} households in {country}. Embroidery, wrap clothing, and hairstyles miniaturize adult dress. Caregiving play teaches social roles; craft techniques pass between generations.

Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: الثياب المغلقة أو الاختباء
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Before industrial rubber, {civ} communities in {country}, loaded and sewed Croatia from hide, cloth, or plant fiber. الإمساك، الركل، والألعاب الدائرة نما حول هذه الأشياء.

Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: محلية تدور فوق الحرف
top_local.descTemplate: Top play is ancient and global; this entry records {country}'s {civ} carving styles, tip materials, and contest etiquette as a distinct craft-and-play practice within that shared physics toy.

Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: أرقام الخيوط المحلية

steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Brinquedo de puxar animal
pull_toy.descTemplate: Animais de rodas e figuras de tração são documentados a partir da antiguidade clássica através de marcenaria aldeia em {country}. Os artesãos {civ} forma cavalos, pássaros,germes ou bois que ensinam crianças andando sobre tração tração e companheirismo em movimento.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: Figura animal de rodas ou deslizando

mini_weapons_toy.title: Brinquedo arco ou jogo de dardo
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Brinquedos de caça em escala permitem que as crianças em {country} ensaiem habilidades celebradas por adultos {civ} – arqueria, dardos de lança-torno ou pontaria – usando materiais mais seguros. Alvos em palha, madeira ou círculos desenhados transformam técnica marcial em jogo marcado.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: Arco/dardos de brinquedo macio ou de baixa potência

jacks_local.title: Pedras de bolso
jacks_local.descTemplate: Para além da família de jonchbones partilhada, o {country} tem sequências de habilidade locais de pedra e semente, moldadas pela infância {civ} — diferentes lançamentos, cantos e escadas de dificuldade sobre o mesmo princípio de captador, registadas aqui como uma entrada de prática regional quando cantos e sequências são localmente distintas.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: glucoso jogo de sorteios
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Lançando lotes para voltas, perdas, ou alertas de história aparece em reuniões {civ} em {country}. Se varas de bambu, ossos do punho, ou dados pintados, o acaso escolhe quem fala, dança ou respostas - um brinquedo social na borda da adivinhação e jogo de festa.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Reproduzir figuras de sombras
shadow_play.descTemplate: O jogo das sombras — animais manuais ou fantoches de couro — entreteve noites em {country} dentro da história {civ}. Luz e silhueta transformar gesto em teatro. Algumas regiões elevaram isto em artes marionetes formais; as sombras das mãos das crianças permanecem a forma de brinquedo.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Artesanato local para papagaios
kite_local.descTemplate: Enquanto o vôo de pipas é uma família global, os fabricantes de {civ} desenvolveram formas distintas, papéis, freios e usos de festivais. Esta entradawiche destaca que a tradição artesanal local como uma prática regional de kite sob o céu mais amplo kite. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.
req: Pipa de papel ou de pano

cloth_doll_local.title: Boneca de pano local
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Bonecas macias vestidas com padrões têxteis locais aparecem em casas {civ} em {country}. Bordado, embrulhe roupas e penteados miniaturizar vestido adulto. O jogo de cuidar ensina papéis sociais; as técnicas artesanais passam entre gerações.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Tecidos de algodão ou de algodão
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Antes de borracha industrial, {civ} comunidades em {country} recheado e costurei bolas de couro, pano, ou fibra vegetal. Pegar, chutar, e jogos de círculo cresceram em torno desses objetos. A marca da bola é tão cultural como as regras.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Tecido, palmeira ou bola de couro

top_local.title: Nave de topo giratório local
top_local.descTemplate: - Sim. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Figuras de cadeias de caracteres locais
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} figuras de cordas ligadas a {country} carregam nomes locais, animais e mitos mesmo quando aberturas se assemelham ao berço do gato em outro lugar. As figuras são diagramas portáteis de história e memória manual.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Quadro de corridas folclóricas (local)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Cross-and-circle e placas de corrida de caminho aparecem em muitos países. Em {country}, os jogadores de {civ} usavam conchas, paus ou ossos de punho para marcar a corrida em casa — primos para estruturas semelhantes a pachisi, mas com formas de pista locais e costumes de espaço seguro registrados como uma placa de corrida folclórica regional.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Sementes e caroços
sowing_local.descTemplate: - Não. Pertencem à família Technology Mancala, mas merecem entradas regionais quando a geometria do tabuleiro e os costumes de captura são padronizados localmente. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Tabuleiro ou poços de copa na terra

jump_rope.title: Jogos de salto de corda
jump_rope.descTemplate: Rimas pulando e pulando corda prosperam nos pátios escolares e ruas de {country} dentro da cultura da infância {civ}. Passos de velocidade Solo e jogos de corda longa grupo compartilham o ritmo saltitante; cantos localizar o brinquedo.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Corda de cânhamo, plástico ou videira

blindfold_tag.title: Jogos de tag / call do homem cego
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Os jogos de busca de vendados – variantes de call-and-dodge – aparecem nas festas {civ} e nas reuniões infantis no {country}. Som, quietude e empatia para o jogador cego estruturam a diversão.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Folk wrestling jogar para a juventude
