Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Gioco di wrestling popolare per i giovani
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Giochi di wrestling per adulti si preparano a stili popolari celebrati da comunità {civ} in {country}. Le versioni di gioco enfatizzano getti sicuri, confini del cerchio e risate sopra le lesioni—sport come giocattolo sociale.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Canto di memoria / eliminazione
memory_song.descTemplate: I canti di eliminazione e le canzoni di memoria, simili a "chi rimane" i giochi di cerchio, sono giocattoli di ritmo e attenzione nella cultura orale {civ} in {country}. Le parole sbagliate o i battiti persi eliminano i giocatori fino a quando non si rimane.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Stilt o pali di equilibrio
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts appaiono come strumenti di festival e giocattoli di equilibrio per bambini in {country}. I creatori di {civ} sollevano i camminatori su bambù, legno o lattine riciclate. Corsa e truciolato trasformano l'elevazione in gioco.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
balance_stilts.participants: Coppie da sole o da corsa

leaf_boat.title: Leaf o Bark boat racing
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Corse in miniatura con foglie, corteccia o corncobs deliziano i bambini vicino all'acqua in {country}. {civ} gioco trasforma le correnti in tracce e artigianato in esperimenti di ingegneria.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Foglie, corteccia o sughero per scafi

snow_or_sand.title: Sand / neve figura giocare
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Sculturare figure temporanee in sabbia o neve è un gioco di costruzione elementare ovunque paesaggi {civ} in {country} forniscono il mezzo. Castelli, animali e forme ancestrali appaiono ed erodono—architettura come giocattolo effimero.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Tavolo calcio flick / calcio di carta
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Giochi di Flick che simulano il calcio/soccer su un tavolo diffuso attraverso le scuole in {country}, stratificato su vecchie abitudini dito-flicking giocattolo in {civ} infanzia. Gli obiettivi sono libri o posti disegnati; i tornei possono essere feroci.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.
req: Moneta, pulsante o palla di carta

riddle_local.title: Scambio di enigmi locali
riddle_local.descTemplate: Scambi di violino in {country} preservare metafora {civ}, ecologia e umorismo. Posare e risolvere sotto pressione del tempo è un giocattolo mentale che non richiede attrezzature prodotte.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Giocattolo del rumore del festival
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: I rumoristi del festival—ratchets, clappers, bastoncini di campana—lascia che i bambini si uniscano ai riti pubblici di {civ} in {country}. Volume e ritmo segnano il calendario; alcuni giocattoli sono stagionali e memorizzati in seguito come marcia rituale.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, bastone campana, clapper, o giocattolo del tamburo

puzzle_knot.title: Giocattolo per puzzle
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Distintangoli puzzle di cordone, anelli e legno appaiono come giocattoli di mercato e curiosità del fabbro intorno a {country}. I giocatori {civ} imparano la topologia con il tocco—rilassa un anello senza forzare, quindi riassembla.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Set di giochi per famiglie in miniatura
mini_house.descTemplate: Piccoli strumenti domestici — pentole in clay, stuoie tessute, mobili per bambole — sostengono il gioco di ruolo della vita domestica adulta in {civ} infanzia in {country}. Archeologia ed etnografia trovano entrambi questi giocattoli didattici.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Bebek rattle
rattle.descTemplate: Rattles en eski ses oyuncakları arasındadır. {country}'de, {civ} bakıcılar uzun süreli mühürlenmiş tohumlar ya da gourd, kik, sepetler veya odun bebek kavrama ve ritmi ödüllendirmek için. Rattle hem duyusal hem de bazı yerlerde koruyucu bir çekicilik sesidir.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.

whistle_toy.title: Clay veya odun ısıtılmış toy
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Küçük ıslıklar - kuş şeklinde çamur, oyma ahşap, yeniden - piyasalarda ve arkeolojik katmanlarda {civ}'de ZZ hayatına bağlı. Çocuklar onları seslendirme oyuncak olarak kullanırlar; festival gürültü yapıcıları olarak bir çift. Ses oyunu nefes öğretir ve oyunla oynar. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.
whistle_toy.participants: Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız

pull_toy.title: Hayvan oyuncak çekiyor
pull_toy.descTemplate: Hayvanları klonladı ve uzun rakamlar ZZRYZZ'deki köy ahşapları aracılığıyla klasik antik çağda belgelenmiştir. {civ} sanatisans atları, kuşları veya oxen'i hareket halindeki traksiyon ve yoldaşlık hakkında öğretir. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
pull_toy.participants: Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız

mini_weapons_toy.title: Toy yay veya dart oyun seti
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Scaled avlanma oyuncakları {country}'de çocukların {civ} yetişkinler tarafından kutlandığı prova becerilerine izin verir - mızrak-thorn darts veya blowor amacı - daha güvenli malzemeler. Şişman, ahşap veya çizilen çevreler oyuna dövüş tekniğini döndürür.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: Pocket beceri taşları
jacks_local.descTemplate: Paylaşılan knuckle Bones ailesinin ötesinde, {country}, {civ} çocukluğu tarafından şekillendirilen yerel bir taşa sahiptir - farklı atlar, karıncalar ve aynı pickup prensibi üzerinde zorluk merdivenleri, burada korantlar ve diziler yerel olarak ayrı ayrı ayrıdır.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Story lot / çizim birçok oyun
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Döndük için çok şey yapın, forfeits veya hikaye {civ} toplantılarında ortaya çıkıyor. bambu sopalar olsun, knuckle Bones, ya da çizildi, konuşma şansı, danslar veya cevaplar – divination ve parti oyunu kenarında sosyal oyuncak. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.
req: Marked sopalar, çok fazla veya dice

shadow_play.title: Shadow rakamlar oyun oynuyor
shadow_play.descTemplate: Shadow oyun – el hayvanları veya deri puppets – {country}'de {civ}’de eğlendirildi. Işık ve silhouette tiyatroya dönüşüyor. Bazı bölgeler bunu resmi kukla sanatlarına yükseltti; çocukların el gölgeleri toy şeklinde kalır.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Yerel kite zanaat
kite_local.descTemplate: Klan uçan bir küresel aile olsa da, {country}’nin {civ} üreticileri farklı şekillerde, kağıtlar, bridler ve festival kullanımları geliştirdi. Bu giriş, yerel zanaat geleneği daha geniş kite gökyüzünün altında bölgesel bir kite uygulaması olarak vurgulamaktadır.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Yerel bezler
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Yerel tekstil desenlerinde giyinmiş yumuşak dolls {civ} hanelerde {country}'de görünür. Giysileri sarmak ve saç stili yetişkin elbiseyi miniturize etmek. Bakım oyun sosyal roller öğretir; zanaat teknikleri nesiller arasında geçer.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.
cloth_doll_local.participants: Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız

ball_sewn.title: Sewn bezi veya topu gizleyin
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Endüstriyel kauçuktan önce, {civ} topluluklarında {country}, gizlenen ve dikilen topları gizlemek, bez veya bitki fiber. Catch, Kick, ve çember oyunları bu nesneler etrafında büyüdü. Top'ın makyajı kurallar olarak kültüreldir.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Sewn bezi, palmiye, ya da top

top_local.title: Localching top zanaat
top_local.descTemplate: Top oyun eski ve küreseldir; bu giriş kayıtları {country}'nin {civ} arabaving stilleri, tip malzemeler ve bu paylaşılan fizik içinde ayrı bir el-ve oyun uygulaması olarak yarışmak.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Yerel dize rakamlar
string_local.descTemplate: {civ}RYZZ ile bağlantılı olan {civ}, yerel isimleri, hayvanları ve efsaneleri, kedinin başka bir yere benzediğini bile taşır. Rakamlar hikayenin ve el belleğinin taşınabilir diyagramlarıdır. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Halk ırkı (yerel)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Cross-and-circle ve yol yarış tahtaları birçok ülkede görünür. {country}'de, {civ} oyuncuları kabuklar, çubuklar veya knuckle Bones'lar ev yarış işaretlerine ev - pachisi benzeri yapılara değil, yerel pist şekilleri ve güvenli alan gümrükleri bölgesel bir halk ırkı olarak kaydedildi.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Local pit-and-seed sowing · tr
sowing_local.descTemplate: Oyunlar {country}'de kök aldı, {civ} tahtaları farklı kupaları, röle kuralları ve ahşap şekilleri gösteriyor. Mancala ailesine aitler henüz yönetim kurulu geometrisinde bölgesel girişleri hak ederler ve gümrükleri yerel olarak standartlaştırır.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Dünya Kupası veya pits in Earth

jump_rope.title: Goping ip oyunları
jump_rope.descTemplate: Skipping ve at-rope rhymes {country}'nin okul bahçesinde ve sokaklarda ZZ çocukluk kültürü içinde gelişti. Solo hız adımları ve uzun süreli oyunlar bouncing ritmini paylaşıyor; karıncalar toy'yi yerelleştiriyor ({civ})
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: Blind man's tag / call games · tr
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Oyun arıyordu – ve-dodge varyantları – {civ} partileri ve çocukların ZZRYZZ'deki toplantıları. Ses, halaness ve kör oyuncu için empati eğlenceyi oluşturur. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Halk güreşi gençler için oyun
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Gençlik güreşi oyunları {civ} toplulukları tarafından kutlanan yetişkin halk stilleri için hazırlanıyor. Play versiyonları güvenli atlar, çember sınırları ve yaralanmadan kahkahalar vurgulamaktadır - sosyal oyuncak olarak spor. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Memory şarkı / elimi ortadan kaldırmak
memory_song.descTemplate: Elimination chants and memory songs - ' kim kalır' çember oyunları - {civ} oral kültürü ZZRYZZ. Yanlış kelimeler ya da kayıp vuruşlar, bir kalana kadar oyuncuları ortadan kaldırır. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Stilts veya denge kutupları
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts festival araçları ve çocukların {country}'deki denge oyuncakları olarak görünür. {civ} üreticileri bambu, ahşap veya geri dönüştürülmüş kanallarda yürüyüşçüler yetiştiriyor. Yarış ve hile- adım oyuna yükselecektir.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: Leaf or bark tekne yarışı
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Miniature tekne yarışları yaprakları, bark veya korcobs ZZRYZZ'de suya yakın çocukları memnun eder. {civ} oyun şu ankiları mühendislik deneylerine dönüştürüyor. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Leaves, bark veya hulls için kork

snow_or_sand.title: Sand / kar figür oyunu
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: kum veya kardaki geçici figürlerin belirlenmesi, {civ}'deki ZZRARYZZ manzaralarının bulunduğu yerde elemental inşaat oyunudur. Castles, hayvanlar ve soy formlar ortaya çıkıyor ve erode – amphemeral toy olarak. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Masa flick futbol / kağıt futbol
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Bir masada futbol/soccer'i simüle eden oyunlar, {country}'deki okullara yayıldı, {civ} çocukluklarında eski parmak-flicking toy alışkanlıklara geçti. Hedefler kitaplar veya çizilen mesajlardır; turnuvalar şiddetli olabilir.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Local riddle exchange · tr
riddle_local.descTemplate: {country}'deki Riddle borsaları {civ} metaforunu, ekolojiyi ve mizahı koruyor. Zaman basıncı altında hareket etmek ve çözmek, üretilen ekipman gerektirmez gerektiren bir zihindir.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Festival gürültü yapımcısı toyyy
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Festival gürültü yapıcıları –korchets, clappers, zil-sticks – çocukları {civ}'de halka açık ritler katılıyor. Cilt ve ritim işareti takvim zamanı; bazı oyuncaklar mevsimseldir ve daha sonra ritüel dişli gibi depolanır. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, zil çubuğu, clapper, ya da davul toy

puzzle_knot.title: Cord & düğüm bulmacası
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Tel, halkalar ve ahşap bulmacaları {country} etrafında piyasa oyuncaklar ve karasmith curiosity olarak görünür. {civ} oyuncuları dokunuşla topoloji öğrenir - zorlamadan bir yüzük serbest bırakır, sonra yeniden kurulur.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.
puzzle_knot.participants: Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız Yalnız

mini_house.title: Miniature ev oyun seti
mini_house.descTemplate: Küçük ev aletleri – ahşap pans, dokuma matlar, doll mobilya - {civ} çocukluklarında yetişkin ev hayatının rolüne destek. Arkeoloji ve etnografi her ikisi de bu öğretim oyuncakları bulur. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Name
rattle.descTemplate: Chó rừng là một trong những đồ chơi âm thanh cổ nhất. Trong ZZZZZOTRRZ, những người chăm sóc ZZZZZZ đã từ lâu có những hạt giống hoặc viên sỏi đóng dấu trong bầu, đất sét, giỏ hoặc gỗ để thưởng cho việc nắm bắt và nhịp điệu của trẻ sơ sinh. Tiếng chuông là cả đồ chơi cảm giác và, ở một số nơi, là một âm thanh bảo vệ. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Thung lũng rung với hạt giống, sỏi đá hoặc chuông
Các vật liệu không độc hại an toàn

whistle_toy.title: Đất sét hay đồ chơi bằng gỗ
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Small whistles—bird-shaped clay, carved wood, reed—appear in markets and archaeological layers tied to {civ} life in {country}. Children use them as voice-amplifying toys; some double as festival noisemakers. Sound play teaches breath and pitch playfully.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.
req: Mở không khí nếu ồn ào

pull_toy.title: Đồ chơi của động vật
pull_toy.descTemplate: Động vật có bánh xe và những con số kéo được ghi lại từ thời cổ đại thông qua các công trình gỗ của làng trong ZZZOTRRZZZ. ZZCVZZ, thợ thủ công tạo hình ngựa, chim, hoặc bò, là những người dạy trẻ biết đi về sức kéo và bạn bè di chuyển. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: Name
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Scaled hunting toys let children in {country} rehearse skills celebrated by {civ} adults—archery, spear-thorn darts, or blowpipe aim—using safer materials. Targets on straw, wood, or drawn circles turn martial technique into scored play.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: Cung đồ chơi mềm hoặc ít sức mạnh
Dọn sạch khu vực cách li

jacks_local.title: Name
jacks_local.descTemplate: Bên ngoài những khớp xương xương tay được chia sẻ, ZZCOTRRZ có những trình tự kỹ năng về đá và hạt giống địa phương được hình thành bởi ZZRIZZZ, ném khác nhau, tụng kinh, và khó khăn trên cùng một nguyên tắc thu thập, được ghi nhận ở đây như là một lối vào khu vực khi các bài hát và chuỗi địa phương khác biệt. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.
req: ♫ Năm hòn đá nhỏ hoặc hạt giống

story_dice_oral.title: Trò chơi nhiều câu chuyện / vẽ nhiều
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Các cuộc họp bằng {civ}Z trong ZZOTRYZZZZ. Cho dù tre que, xương đòn, hay là những con xúc xắc, cơ hội chọn ai nói, nhảy, hay câu trả lời là đồ chơi xã hội ở rìa trò chơi bói toán và đảng. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.
req: Thẻ đánh dấu, rất nhiều hoặc súc sắc

shadow_play.title: Trò chơi hình bóng
shadow_play.descTemplate: Trò chơi bóng đêm - động vật tay hay con rối da - đã vui chơi đêm trong ZZOTRRZZZ trong câu chuyện {civ}Z. Ánh sáng và hình dáng biến cử chỉ thành rạp hát. Một số vùng đã nâng điều này thành nghệ thuật rối chính thức; bóng bàn tay của trẻ em vẫn là hình thức đồ chơi. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Name
kite_local.descTemplate: While kite flying is one global family, {country}'s {civ} makers developed distinctive shapes, papers, bridles, and festival uses. This entry highlights that local craft tradition as a regional kite practice under the wider kite sky.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: búp bê vải cục bộ
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Những con búp bê mềm mặc đồ dệt may ở địa phương xuất hiện trên ZZCVZZZZZ ở ZZCOTRRZZ. Quần áo, quần áo và kiểu tóc thu nhỏ quần áo người lớn. Người chăm sóc trò chơi dạy người ta vai trò xã hội; kỹ thuật thủ công đi qua giữa các thế hệ. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Những mảnh vải hoặc bóng ẩn
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Trước khi cao su công nghiệp, các cộng đồng {civ}ZZZZZZZ nhồi bông và may những quả bóng khỏi chỗ nấp, vải hoặc sợi thực vật. Bắt, đá, và vòng tròn trò chơi mọc xung quanh những vật thể này. Trái banh được tạo ra cũng văn hóa như quy tắc. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Giấy đúc, cọ hoặc bóng ẩn

top_local.title: Name
top_local.descTemplate: Top play is ancient and global; this entry records {country}'s {civ} carving styles, tip materials, and contest etiquette as a distinct craft-and-play practice within that shared physics toy.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Hình dãy cục bộ
string_local.descTemplate: Những con số liên quan đến ZZZOTRRZ mang theo tên địa phương, động vật và thần thoại ngay cả khi mở cửa giống như nôi mèo ở nơi khác. Các hình vẽ là biểu đồ di động của câu chuyện và bộ nhớ tay. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Bảng đua chớm (local)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Ở nhiều vùng đất, các đường đua và đường đi đều xuất hiện. Trong ZZZZOTRRZZ, {civ} đã sử dụng vỏ sò, gậy, hoặc xương đòn để đánh dấu về nhà - các dấu vết cho các cấu trúc giống pachisi nhưng với các hình dạng và phong tục không gian an toàn được ghi nhận là một bảng dân gian khu vực. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Gieo hố và gieo giống địa phương
sowing_local.descTemplate: Where sowing games took root in {country}, {civ} boards show distinctive cup counts, relay rules, and wood shapes. They belong to the mancala family yet deserve regional entries when board geometry and capture customs are locally standardized.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: Đang bỏ qua trò chơi dây thừng
jump_rope.descTemplate: Bỏ qua và nhảy xuống những giai điệu phát triển mạnh trong sân trường và đường phố trong nền văn hóa thời thơ ấu ZZCRIZZZZZZ. Solo speed Steps và nhóm các trò chơi dây dài chia sẻ nhịp điệu nhảy múa; tụng địa phương hóa đồ chơi. ({country}, {civ})
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Dây thừng, nhựa hoặc dây leo

blindfold_tag.title: Tên người mù
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Những trò chơi có hình chữ nhật xuất hiện trong các bữa tiệc ZCRIZZZZ và những cuộc họp mặt trẻ em trong ZZCTRRZZZ. Âm thanh, sự tĩnh lặng và sự đồng cảm đối với người mù tạo nên niềm vui. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Trò chơi đấu vật cho giới trẻ
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Trò chơi đấu vật thời trẻ chuẩn bị cho những phong cách dân gian người lớn được tổ chức bởi cộng đồng ZZCVZZZZ ở ZZZZZZTTRZ. Chơi phiên bản nhấn mạnh ném an toàn, vòng tròn ranh giới, và cười trên thương tích - vận động như đồ chơi xã hội. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Bài hát bộ nhớ / loại bỏ tụng
memory_song.descTemplate: Elimination chants and memory songs—akin to 'who remains' circle games—are toys of rhythm and attention in {civ} oral culture in {country}. Wrong words or missed beats eliminate players until one remains.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.
req: Bài hát chia sẻ hay hát:94

balance_stilts.title: Cột hay đòn thăng bằng
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts xuất hiện như là công cụ cho lễ hội và đồ chơi cân bằng trẻ em trong ZZZOTRRZZ. Những người chế tạo ZZZZZ nuôi xác bằng tre, gỗ hoặc lon tái chế. Chạy đua và nhảy dù biến độ cao thành trò chơi. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: Đôi cà rốt hay trụ thiếc

leaf_boat.title: Name
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Thuyền nhỏ chạy bằng lá, vỏ cây hoặc bắp khiến trẻ em thích thú gần mặt nước trong ZZOTRRZZ. ZCIVZZ biến dòng chảy thành dấu vết và thủ công thành thí nghiệm kỹ thuật. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Lá, vỏ cây hay nút chai cho thân tàu

snow_or_sand.title: Cát / tuyết hình ảnh chơi
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Những hình ảnh tạm thời trên cát hoặc tuyết là xây dựng nguyên tố chơi ở bất cứ nơi nào ZCIVZZZZ trong ZZZOTRZZ cung cấp phương tiện. Các lâu đài, thú vật, và hình dạng tổ tiên xuất hiện và xói mòn hình thức đồ chơi tiên phong. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Name
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Những trò chơi điện tử giả lập bóng bầu dục/nhà sản xuất trên bàn trải dài khắp các trường học trong ZZZOTRRRZZ, được chia thành những thói quen cũ trong thời thơ ấu ZZCRIZZZZZ. Mục tiêu là sách hoặc những bài rút ra; các giải đấu có thể rất mãnh liệt. ({country}, {civ})
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Giao dịch câu đố cục bộ
riddle_local.descTemplate: Các cuộc trao đổi bằng ZZCOTRRRRZZZZ{civ} ẩn dụ, sinh học và hài hước. Việc phân tích và giải quyết dưới áp lực thời gian là một ý tưởng về đồ chơi không cần thiết bị sản xuất. ({country}, {civ})
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.
req: Thẩm phán trưởng lão tùy chọn

ceremonial_toy.title: Đồ chơi làm ồn
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Những người tạo ra tiếng ồn trong lễ hội, những người vỗ tay, những cái gậy chuông cho trẻ em tham gia vào nghi lễ công cộng ZZCRIZZZZZ trong ZZCTRRZZZ. Âm lượng và nhịp điệu đánh dấu thời gian lịch; một số đồ chơi theo mùa và được lưu trữ sau đó giống như các bánh răng. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, bellstick, vỗ tay, hoặc trống đồ chơi
ceremonial_toy.participants: Một mình hay một nhóm diễu hành.

puzzle_knot.title: Name
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Những câu đố lộn xộn về dây, nhẫn và gỗ xuất hiện như đồ chơi thị trường và những món quà của thợ rèn quanh ZZOTTRZZZZ. ZRIZZZ, học địa hình bằng cách chạm vào một chiếc nhẫn mà không cần ép buộc, rồi lắp lại. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Bộ chơi trò chơi nhà nhỏ
mini_house.descTemplate: Tiny household tools—clay pans, woven mats, doll furniture—support role-play of adult domestic life in {civ} childhoods in {country}. Archaeology and ethnography both find these teaching toys.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: ทารก
rattle.descTemplate: เห็ด เป็น ของ เล่น เสียง ที่ เก่า แก่ ที่ สุด. ผู้ ปรนนิบัติ ดู แล ท้อง ถิ่น การ สั่น สะเทือน เป็น ทั้ง ของ เล่น ประสาท สัมผัส และ ใน บาง แห่ง เป็น เสียง ที่ ให้ การ ปก ป้อง. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: ฟ้า ร้อง ด้วย เมล็ด, ก้อน กรวด, หรือ ระฆัง
วัสดุที่ไม่ใช่สารพิษที่ปลอดภัย
rattle.participants: โดดเดี่ยว (เด็กกับผู้ดูแล)

whistle_toy.title: มือไม้หรือของเล่น
whistle_toy.descTemplate: นกหวีดขนาดเล็ก ดินเผารูปนก ไม้แกะสลัก ไม้ไผ่ -- มองเห็นในตลาดและชั้นทางโบราณคดี เด็ก ๆ ใช้พวกเขาเป็นของเล่นเสียงเสียง; บางคู่เป็นเทศกาลสร้างเสียงรบกวน การเล่นเสียงสอนการหายใจและการวางท่าอย่างสนุกสนาน. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.
req: นกหวีดของเล่น
ควบคุมลมหายใจ
อ้าปาก ถ้าเสียงดัง

pull_toy.title: สัตว์ดึงของเล่น
pull_toy.descTemplate: มีบันทึกจากโบราณกาล ผ่านงานไม้ในหมู่บ้านใน ZZCOLYE. ช่าง ฝีมือ ที่ มี ความ ชํานาญ หลาย คน มี รูป ร่าง เหมือน ม้า, นก, หรือ วัว ที่ สอน เด็ก เล็ก ๆ ที่ เดิน ไป มา เกี่ยว กับ อิง  อาศัย และ มิตรภาพ. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: สัตว์ ที่ ถูก ล้อ หรือ ไถล
พื้นที่พื้น

mini_weapons_toy.title: คันธนูของเล่นหรือชุดลูกดอก
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: ของเล่นการล่าสเกลย์ทําให้เด็กๆ สามารถซ้อมได้โดยผู้ใหญ่ SOZCIZC เฉลิมฉลอง - - - เป้า หมาย บน ฟาง, ไม้, หรือ วัฏจักร ที่ ถูก crowbarอง เปลี่ยน เทคนิค การ ต่อ สู้ ให้ เป็น การ เล่น ที่ ได้ คะแนน. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: ของเล่นแบบอ่อนหรือใช้กําลังน้อย
ล้างพื้นที่ลดหลั่น

jacks_local.title: ก้อน นิ่ว ที่ มี ความ ชํานาญ
jacks_local.descTemplate: นอกเหนือไปจากการแบ่งปันของกระดูกข้อนิ้ว ฌองจั่นมีทักษะท้องถิ่นของหินและเมล็ด มีลําดับจากวัยเด็ก SOZCIV. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.
req: ห้าหินขนาดเล็กหรือเมล็ด

story_dice_oral.title: เรื่องของเรื่อง / วาดภาพเกมจํานวนมาก
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: การ จับ ฉลาก เพื่อ การ หัก หลัง, การ สูญ เสีย, หรือ เรื่อง ราว ต่าง ๆ ปรากฏ ใน การ ชุมนุม กัน อย่าง อึกทึก ใน ฌ็อง ค ริ ตี. ไม่ว่าจะเป็นไม้ไผ่, กระดูกข้อนิ้ว, หรือลูกเต๋าสี, โอกาสที่จะเลือกผู้ที่พูด, เต้นรําหรือคําตอบ -- ของเล่นสังคมที่ขอบของคําทํานายและเกม. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.
req: แท่งปักหมุด, จํานวนมาก, หรือลูกเต๋า
ภาษาที่ใช้ร่วมกัน

shadow_play.title: วาดภาพเงาเล่น
shadow_play.descTemplate: การเล่นเงา -- สัตว์มือหรือหุ่นเชิดหนัง -- มีความบันเทิงคืนใน Jazcyzจะใช้เวลา แสงและเงาเปลี่ยนท่าทางเป็นโรงละคร บางภูมิภาคยกสิ่งนี้ขึ้นเป็นศิลปะการหุ่นเชิดอย่างเป็นทางการ เงามือของเด็กๆยังคงเป็นรูปของเล่น. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.
req: โคมไฟหรือไฟ
กําแพงว่าง
มือหรือหุ่นเชิดตัดออก

kite_local.title: เครื่องมือเล่นคําภายใน
kite_local.descTemplate: ขณะที่การบินของว่าวเป็นหนึ่งตระกูลทั่วโลก ฌองครุยซ นักประดิษฐ์ของจุฬาลงกรณ์ได้พัฒนารูปร่างที่โดดเด่น กระดาษ บังเหียน และการใช้เทศกาล รายการ นี้ เน้น ว่า ประเพณี ของ ท้อง ถิ่น เป็น กิจ ปฏิบัติ ของ ว่าว ใน ภูมิภาค ภาย ใต้ ท้องฟ้า ที่ กว้าง กว่า. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.
req: กระดาษหรือว่าวผ้า
เส้นนําทาง
kite_local.participants: คนเดียวหรือ 2 คน

cloth_doll_local.title: ตุ๊กตาผ้าท้องถิ่น
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: ตุ๊กตา อ่อน ที่ สวม เสื้อ ผ้า ใน ท้อง ถิ่น ดู เหมือน จะ อยู่ ทั่ว บ้าน ที่ มี น้ํา หนัก เบา ใน ทะเล ทราย. เครื่อง สําอาง เสื้อ ผ้า และ ทรง ผม ทํา ให้ เสื้อ ผ้า ของ ผู้ ใหญ่ สั้น ลง. การ ดู แล เด็ก. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.
req: การยัดอุปกรณ์
เธรดหรือเครือญาติ

ball_sewn.title: ผ้า หรือ ลูก ลื่น
ball_sewn.descTemplate: ก่อน จะ ใช้ ยาง อุตสาหกรรม ชุมชน ซัค เซน ใน ซ็ อด เท อร์ ไรซ์ ยัด และทําเรื่อง เย็บ ลูก บอล จาก หนัง, ผ้า, หรือ เส้นใย พืช. จับ, เตะ, และวงกลมเกมเติบโตรอบวัตถุเหล่านี้ ลูกบอลเป็นวัฒนธรรมตามกฏ. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: ผ้า, ต้น ปาล์ม, หรือ ลูก ลื่น
เปิดช่องว่างในการเล่น

top_local.title: ยานด้านบนหมุนภายใน
top_local.descTemplate: ละครยอดเยี่ยมเป็นละครแนวโบราณและทั่วโลก รายการนี้บันทึกเสียงของ ZZCONTCIZE แบบแกะสลัก, วัสดุเคล็ดลับ, และมารยาทในการแข่งขัน. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.
req: ลบทั้งเธรด
สาย หรือ แส้

string_local.title: ตัวเลขข้อความภายในระบบ
string_local.descTemplate: ตัว เลข ที่ เกี่ยว ข้อง กับ ฌ็อง โค รี ซัค มี ชื่อ ท้อง ถิ่น, สัตว์, และ เทพนิยาย แม้ แต่ เมื่อ เปิด ดู คล้าย เปล แมว ใน ที่ อื่น ๆ. ตัวเลขเป็นแผนภาพของเรื่องราวและความทรงจํามือ. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.
req: สี่เหลี่ยมหรือวงกลม
ความรู้เรื่องราวเลือกใช้
string_local.participants: คนเดียวหรือ 2 คน

board_race_folk.title: โฟล์คบอร์ดแข่ง (local)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: และเส้นทางแข่งบอร์ดปรากฏในหลาย ๆ ประเทศ ใน ZZCONTRYZ, เครื่องเล่น SOZCIVS ใช้กระสุน, ไม้, หรือกระดูกข้อนิ้วเป็นเครื่องหมายแข่งที่บ้าน --. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.
req: กระดานติดตามหรือผ้า
ตัวทําเครื่องหมาย
ความ ลึก, ไม้ เรียว, หรือ เปลือก หอย

sowing_local.title: การหว่านพืชท้องถิ่น
sowing_local.descTemplate: เมื่อ เกม หว่าน ฝัง ราก ลง ไป ใน ไอ ซี โค ริง ไร turned กระดาน ไอ ซี ไอ เซน แสดง จํานวน ถ้วย ที่ โดด เด่น, กฎ ผลัด, และ รูป ทรง ไม้. พวกเขาอยู่ในตระกูลแมนคาล่า แต่สมควรได้รับรายการระดับภูมิภาค เมื่อคณะกรรมการเรขาคณิตและการเก็บภาษี. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: กระดานถ้วยหรือหลุมในแผ่นดิน
เมล็ด หรือ ก้อน กรวด

jump_rope.title: เกมข้ามเชือก
jump_rope.descTemplate: การข้ามและกระโดดเชือกบทกวี ประสบความสําเร็จในลานเรียนและถนนในวัฒนธรรมเยาวชน ZZCOICK. Solo ความเร็วขั้นตอนและกลุ่มเกมยาว ร่วมกันจังหวะกระเด้ง; สวดในท้องถิ่นของเล่น. ({country}, {civ})
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: ผล ของ ฝูง แกะ, พลาสติก, หรือ เถา องุ่น
หมุนแบบเสริม

blindfold_tag.title: แท็กของคนตาบอด / เรียกเกม
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: เกมที่ปิดไม่ลงเข้ามาในสายตา -- การเรียกและ dodridges -- มองเห็นทั่ว CHISCIVE ปาร์ตีและการชุมนุมของเด็กใน ZZCOTRYZE. เสียง, ความ เงียบ, และ ความ ร่วม รู้สึก ของ ผู้ เล่น ที่ ตา บอด เป็น โครง สร้าง ความ สนุก. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.
req: ปิดไม่น่าจะใช่
พื้นที่ว่างปลอดภัย
ขอบเขตที่ตกลง

wrestling_play.title: เกมมวยปล้ําสําหรับเยาวชน
wrestling_play.descTemplate: เกม ปล้ํา สู้ ใน วัย หนุ่ม สาว เพลย์เวอร์ชันเน้นการโยนแบบปลอดภัย วงกลมเขตแดน และการหัวเราะมากกว่าอาการบาดเจ็บ -- เปิดตัวเป็นของเล่นทางสังคม. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.
req: พื้นหรือทรายอ่อน
เห็นด้วยที่มีกฎ
ปรับปรุงใหม่
wrestling_play.participants: 2 คน (เพิ่มผู้อ้างอิง)

memory_song.title: เพลงความจํา / การถอดเสียงสวด
memory_song.descTemplate: การท่องบทสวดและเพลงจํา -- Acin to'ที่ยังคงเล่นเกมวงกลม' -- เป็นของเล่นของจังหวะและความสนใจในวัฒนธรรมปาก SOCIVE ใน HOZCOUNTRY. คําผิดหรือพลาดจังหวะกําจัดผู้เล่นจนกระทั่งเหลือหนึ่ง. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.
req: เพลงที่ใช้ร่วมกันหรือบทสวด
วงเวียนของผู้เล่น

balance_stilts.title: เส้นเชือกหรือยอด
balance_stilts.descTemplate: สติลท์ปรากฏเป็นเครื่องมือสําหรับเทศกาล และของเล่นสมดุลของเด็กๆ ในช็อคโครี่ เครื่อง มือ ที่ มี ประสิทธิภาพ การชิงแชมป์และขั้นตอนหลอก เปลี่ยนความสูงเป็นการเล่น. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: โพรงไม้สน หรือไม้ค้ํา
สปอตเตอร์สําหรับมือใหม่
balance_stilts.participants: คู่ แข่ง เดียว หรือ คู่ แข่ง

leaf_boat.title: การ แข่ง เรือ ใบ
leaf_boat.descTemplate: การ แข่ง เรือ ขนาด จิ๋ว โดย ใช้ ใบ ไม้, เปลือก ไม้, หรือ ข้าว โพด ทํา ให้ เด็ก ๆ ชื่น ใจ เมื่อ อยู่ ใกล้ ๆ น้ํา ใน ทะเล โขง. เกม EXCIVES เปลี่ยนกระแสให้เป็นรางรถไฟ และสร้างเป็นการทดลองทางวิศวกรรม. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: ใบ ไม้, เปลือก ไม้, หรือ ไม้ ก๊อก สําหรับ ตัว เรือ
ลําธาร, ท่อ ระบาย น้ํา, หรือ อ่าง เก็บ น้ํา
เลือกเสากระโดง

snow_or_sand.title: แซนด์/ หิมะเล่น
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: การ เรียง ตัว เป็น ตัว เลข ชั่ว คราว ใน ทราย หรือ หิมะ เป็น เกม ก่อ สร้าง ธาตุ ไม่ ว่า จะ เป็น บริเวณ ใด ก็ ตาม ที่ มี พื้น ที่ มาก มาย ใน เขต ทะเล ทราย เป็น แหล่ง น้ํา ที่ ให้ ความ สดชื่น แก่ สื่อ ต่าง ๆ. ปราสาท, สัตว์, และรูปทรงของบรรพบุรุษปรากฏและกัดเซาะ -- architecture เป็นของเล่น epherial. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.
req: ทราย หรือ หิมะ
มือ หรือ แบบ ง่าย ๆ
น้ําใช้เป็นทราย
snow_or_sand.participants: อยู่คนเดียวหรือกลุ่ม

knuckle_football.title: ฟุตบอลลูกกลิ้งโต๊ะ / หนังสือพิมพ์
knuckle_football.descTemplate: เกมฟลิคที่จําลองฟุตบอล/ซัคเซอร์ บนโต๊ะที่แพร่กระจายไปทั่วโรงเรียนใน ZCONTRYCE, ชั้นบนบนของเล่นที่เก่ากว่า เป้า หมาย คือ หนังสือ หรือ โพสต์; การ แข่งขัน อาจ ดุ ร้าย ได้. ({country}, {civ})
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.
req: เหรียญ, ปุ่ม, หรือ ลูก กระดาษ
ตารางเครื่องหมายเป้าหมาย

riddle_local.title: แลกเปลี่ยนปริศนาภายใน
riddle_local.descTemplate: การแลกเปลี่ยนริดเดิ้ลใน ZZ warmcyze รักษาอุปมา SOZCIVZ, ระบบนิเวศ, และอารมณ์ขัน การ หมกมุ่น และ การ แก้ ปัญหา ภาย ใต้ ความ กดดัน ใน เวลา อัน ควร เป็น ของ เล่น ที่ จิตใจ ต้อง ไม่ ใช้ อุปกรณ์ ที่ ผลิต ขึ้น มา. ({country}, {civ})
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.
req: ภาษาที่ใช้ร่วมกัน
ผู้ ปกครอง ที่ เลือก ไว้

ceremonial_toy.title: ของ เล่น
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: ผู้สร้างเสียงรบกวนในเทศกาล -- แร็ปเช็ท, ปรบ มือ, ระฆัง -- ให้เด็กๆ เข้าร่วมพิธีกรรมสาธารณะ SOZCIVE ใน ZZCOTRYZE. หนังสือ และ จังหวะ กําหนด เวลา ของ ปฏิทิน; ของ เล่น บาง อย่าง มี ฤดู กาล และ เก็บ ไว้ หลัง จาก นั้น เหมือน อุปกรณ์ ทาง พิธีกรรม. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: แรทเช็ท, เบล แท่ง, สแลมเปอร์, หรือ ของ เล่น กลอง
การ แสดง ความ นับถือ ใน บริบท
ceremonial_toy.participants: อยู่คนเดียวหรือกลุ่มพาเหรด

puzzle_knot.title: ของเล่นสําหรับไขปริศนา
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: ปริศนา เกี่ยว กับ ความ แตก ต่าง ของ เชือก, วง แหวน, และ ไม้ ปรากฏ ว่า เป็น ของ เล่น ใน ตลาด และ เป็น ช่าง ตี เหล็ก ที่ มี ชํานิ ชํานาญ รอบ ๆ ฌ็อง ค ริ ตี. ผู้เล่น SOZCIZZ เรียนรู้วิทยาการระดับสูงสุดด้วยการสัมผัส -- ปลดปล่อยแหวนโดยไม่ต้องใช้แรงกล้า จากนั้นประกอบใหม่. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.
req: คอร์ด, แหวน, หรือ ปริศนา ลวด

mini_house.title: ชุดการเล่นในครัวเรือนขนาดเล็ก
mini_house.descTemplate: เครื่องมือบ้านเล็ก ๆ เช่น กระทะซีเลย์, เสื่อทอผ้า, เฟอร์นิเจอร์ตุ๊กตา -- สนับสนุนการเล่นบทบาทของผู้ใหญ่ในชีวิตผู้ใหญ่ในวัยเด็ก hasCIVE ใน SZCOUNTRY.บ้างรึเปล่า. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.
req: หม้อ ขนาด เล็ก, เสื่อ, หรือ ตุ๊กตา
พื้นที่การเล่นขนาดเล็ก
mini_house.participants: คนเดียวหรือ 2 คน

rattle.title: Bayi mainan
rattle.descTemplate: Rattle adalah salah satu mainan suara tertua. Di {country}, pengasuh {civ} telah lama disegel benih atau kerikil dalam labu, tanah liat, basketry, atau kayu untuk menghargai bayi menggenggam dan irama. Raungan adalah baik mainan sensorik dan, di beberapa tempat, suara pesona pelindung.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: [id] Hollow rattle with seeds, pebbles, or bells

whistle_toy.title: Clay or wood whistle toy · id
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Siulan kecil - burung-berbentuk tanah liat, kayu diukir, buluh - muncul di pasar dan lapisan arkeologi terikat dengan {civ} hidup di {country}. Anak-anak menggunakannya sebagai suara - memperkuat mainan; beberapa ganda sebagai pembuat suara festival. Sound play mengajarkan napas dan lapangan bermain.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Hewan menarik mainan
pull_toy.descTemplate: Hewan beroda dan tokoh sepanjang didokumentasikan dari jaman dahulu melalui hutan desa di {country}. {civ} seniman membentuk kuda, burung, atau sapi yang mengajar berjalan balita tentang traksi dan persahabatan bergerak.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: Toy busur atau panah bermain set
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Mainan berburu skala membiarkan anak-anak di {country} berlatih keterampilan dirayakan oleh {civ} dewasa - pemanah, panah duri, atau blowpipe bertujuan - menggunakan bahan yang lebih aman. Target pada jerami, kayu, atau ditarik lingkaran Teknik bela diri berubah menjadi skor bermain.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: Soft or low-power toy bow / dart

jacks_local.title: Keahlian saku
jacks_local.descTemplate: Selain keluarga knucklebones bersama, {country} memiliki batu lokal - dan-benih urutan keterampilan dibentuk oleh {civ} masa kanak-kanak - berbeda melempar, nyanyian, dan kesulitan tangga pada prinsip pickup yang sama, dicatat di sini sebagai entri praktek regional ketika nyanyian dan urutan lokal berbeda.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Cerita banyak / menggambar banyak permainan
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Casting banyak untuk berubah, pemalsuan, atau cerita prompt muncul di {civ} pertemuan di {country}. Apakah bambu tongkat, knucklebones, atau dadu dicat, kesempatan memilih yang berbicara, tarian, atau jawaban - mainan sosial di tepi ramalan dan permainan partai.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Bayangan dimainkan
shadow_play.descTemplate: Permainan bayangan - tangan binatang atau boneka kulit - telah menghibur malam di {country} dalam cerita ZZえVZZ. Cahaya dan siluet mengubah gerakan menjadi teater. Beberapa daerah mengangkat ini ke dalam seni boneka formal; bayangan tangan anak-anak tetap bentuk mainan ({civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Pesawat layang-layang lokal
kite_local.descTemplate: Sementara layang-layang terbang adalah salah satu keluarga global, {country} 's Z{civ} pembuat khusus dikembangkan bentuk, kertas, jembatan, dan menggunakan festival.
