Catatan ini menyoroti tradisi kerajinan lokal sebagai praktek layang-layang regional di bawah langit layang-layang yang lebih luas.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Boneka kain lokal
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Boneka lembut berpakaian dalam pola tekstil lokal muncul di {civ} rumah tangga di {country}. Embridery, membungkus pakaian, dan gaya rambut meminimalkan gaun dewasa. Permainan amal mengajarkan peran sosial; teknik kerajinan lulus antar generasi.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Kain dijahit atau bola tersembunyi
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Sebelum industri karet, {civ} komunitas di {country} boneka dan menjahit bola dari kulit, kain, atau serat tanaman. Menangkap, menendang, dan permainan lingkaran tumbuh di sekitar objek ini. Membuat bola adalah sebagai budaya sebagai aturan.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Kain dijahit, telapak tangan, atau menyembunyikan bola

top_local.title: Dulu ada yang berputar
top_local.descTemplate: Top play adalah kuno dan global; catatan entri ini {country}Z 's gaya ukiran {civ}, bahan tip, dan kontes etiket sebagai yang berbeda keterampilan-dan-bermain praktek dalam bahwa mainan fisika bersama.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Figure string lokal
string_local.descTemplate: Sosok string {civ} terkait dengan {country} membawa nama lokal, hewan, dan mitos bahkan ketika pembukaan menyerupai cradle kucing di tempat lain. Angka-angka adalah diagram portabel cerita dan memori tangan.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Papan balap folk (lokal)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Cross-dan-lingkaran dan jalur papan balap muncul di banyak negeri. Di {country}, pemain {civ} menggunakan kerang, tongkat, atau knuckbones untuk penanda ras rumah - sepupu untuk pachisi- seperti struktur tetapi dengan bentuk trek lokal dan aman-ruang pabean direkam sebagai papan balap masyarakat regional.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Pita lokal dan benih menabur
sowing_local.descTemplate: Dimana permainan menanam akar di {country}, papan Z{civ} menunjukkan jumlah cangkir yang khas, aturan relay, dan bentuk kayu. Mereka milik keluarga mancala namun layak entri regional ketika geometri papan dan menangkap adat lokal standardisasi.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Pompa papan atau lubang di bumi

jump_rope.title: Melewati permainan tali
jump_rope.descTemplate: Melewati dan melompat sajak tali berkembang di sekolah {country} dan jalan-jalan dalam budaya {civ} masa kanak-kanak. Langkah kecepatan tunggal dan grup panjang-tali game berbagi irama memantul; nyanyian lokal mainan.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: Permainan tag / panggilan orang buta
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Penutup mata mencari permainan - call- dan menghindari varian - muncul di pesta {civ} dan pertemuan anak-anak di {country}. Suara, keheningan, dan empati untuk pemain buta struktur menyenangkan.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Permainan gulat rakyat untuk pemuda.
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Permainan gulat pemuda mempersiapkan gaya rakyat dewasa dirayakan oleh {civ} komunitas di {country}. Mainkan versi menekankan aman melempar, batas lingkaran, dan tawa atas cedera - olahraga sebagai mainan sosial.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Nyanyian memori / eliminasi
memory_song.descTemplate: Nyanyian eliminasi dan lagu memori - mirip dengan 'yang tetap' permainan lingkaran - adalah mainan irama dan perhatian dalam budaya oral Z{civ} di {country}. Salah kata atau tidak terjawab mengalahkan pemain sampai satu tetap.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Tongkat atau tiang keseimbangan
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Tongkat muncul sebagai alat festival dan Dekat mainan anak-anak di {country}. {civ} membuat walker di bambu, kayu, atau kaleng daur ulang. Balapan dan trik. Beralih menjadi permainan.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: Daun atau kulit perahu balap
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Miniatur kapal ras menggunakan daun, kulit, atau tongkol jagung menyenangkan anak-anak dekat air di {country}. {civ} bermain mengubah arus menjadi trek dan kerajinan menjadi percobaan rekayasa.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: [id] Leaves, bark, or cork for hulls

snow_or_sand.title: Sand / snow figure play · id
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Patung -Di pasir atau salju adalah permainan konstruksi elemental dimanapun pemandangan {civ} di {country} menyediakan medium. Istana, hewan, dan bentuk leluhur muncul dan mengikis - arsitektur sebagai mainan fana.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Tabel film sepakbola / sepak bola kertas
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick game yang mensimulasikan sepak bola / sepak bola di atas meja menyebar melalui sekolah-sekolah di {country}, berlapis ke jari-jari tua-berkedip mainan kebiasaan dalam {civ} masa kecil. Tujuan adalah buku atau gambar; turnamen bisa sengit.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Pertukaran teka-teki lokal
riddle_local.descTemplate: Pertukaran Riddle dalam {country} melestarikan Z{civ} metafora, ekologi, dan humor. Posisi dan pemecahan dibawah tekanan waktu adalah mainan pikiran yang tidak membutuhkan peralatan buatan.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Mainan pembuat suara Festival
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Festival pembuat suara - ratchets, clappers, bell-stick - biarkan anak-anak bergabung {civ} upacara publik di {country}. Volume dan rhythm tanda kalender waktu; beberapa mainan musiman dan disimpan sesudahnya seperti ritual gigi.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, bell stick, clapper, atau drum toy

puzzle_knot.title: Cord & knot mainan teka-teki
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Kebingungan teka-teki tali, cincin, dan kayu muncul sebagai mainan pasar dan rasa ingin tahu pandai besi di sekitar {country}. {civ} pemain belajar topologi dengan sentuhan - melepaskan cincin tanpa memaksa, kemudian menyusun kembali.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Miniatur pengaturan rumah tangga
mini_house.descTemplate: Alat-alat rumah tangga kecil - wajan tanah liat, tikar ditenun, boneka furnitur - mendukung role- bermain kehidupan domestik dewasa di {civ} masa kanak-kanak di {country}. Arkeologi dan etnografi keduanya menemukan mainan pengajaran ini.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Kinderratel
rattle.descTemplate: Ratels behoren tot de oudste geluidsspeelgoed. In ZZCO geschetste {civ} verzorgers hebben lange sealed zaden of kiezels in gourde, klei, mand, of hout om baby grijpen en ritme te belonen. De ratel is zowel zintuiglijk speelgoed als, op sommige plaatsen, een beschermende charme geluid. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Holle ratel met zaden, kiezels of klokken

whistle_toy.title: Klei of houtfluit speelgoed
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Kleine fluitende vogelvormige klei, gesneden hout, riet verschijnen in markten en archeologische lagen gebonden aan {civ} leven in ZZCOUNRYZZ. Kinderen gebruiken ze als stemversterkend speelgoed; sommige dubbel als festival noisemakers. Sound play leert adem en pitch speels. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Dieren trekken speelgoed
pull_toy.descTemplate: Wheeled dieren en trekfiguren zijn gedocumenteerd van klassieke oudheid tot dorpshout in {country}. {civ} ambachtslieden vormen paarden, vogels of ossen die wandelende peuters leren over tractie en gezelschap in beweging.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: Aantal dieren op wielen of glijdend

mini_weapons_toy.title: Speelgoedboog of dartspel set
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Geschaald jachtspeelgoed laat kinderen in {country} repeteren vaardigheden gevierd door {civ} volwassenen Archie, spear-thorn darts, of blowpipe aiming met behulp van veiliger materialen. Doelen op stro, hout of getrokken cirkelsverzadigde vechttechniek veranderen in gescoord spel.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: Zakvaardigheidsstenen
jacks_local.descTemplate: Naast de gedeelde knucklebones familie, ZZCOUNRYZZ heeft lokale steen-en-zaad vaardigheid sequenties gevormd door {civ} kindertijd verschillende gooit, gezangen, en moeilijkheidsladders op hetzelfde pick-up principe, opgenomen hier als een regionale praktijk ingang wanneer gezangen en sequenties lokaal onderscheiden. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Story lots / loting lots game
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Bij {civ}-bijeenkomsten in ZZCOUNTHERYZZ worden partijen voor beurten, verbeurde bedragen of verhalen gevraagd. Of bamboe sticks, knucklebones, of geschilderde dobbelstenen, kans kiest wie spreekt, danst, of antwoorden een sociaal speelgoed aan de rand van goddelijkheid en feestspel. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Schaduwfiguren afspelen
shadow_play.descTemplate: Schaduwspelen handdieren of lederen poppen heeft vermaakt nachten in ZZCOUNRYZZ binnen {civ} verhalen vertellen. Licht en silhouet veranderen gebaar in theater. Sommige regio's verhoogde dit in formele marionetkunsten; de schaduwen van de kinderhand blijven de vorm van speelgoed. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Lokale vlieger vaartuigen
kite_local.descTemplate: Terwijl vlieger vliegen is een wereldwijde familie, ZZCOUNRYZZ's {civ} makers ontwikkelde onderscheidende vormen, papier, hoofdstel en festival toepassingen. Dit item benadrukt dat lokale ambachtelijke traditie als een regionale vlieger praktijk onder de bredere kite lucht. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Lokale doekpop
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Zachte poppen gekleed in lokale textielpatronen18 verschijnen in {civ} huishoudens. Borduur, wikkel kleding, en kapsels miniaturiseren volwassen jurk. Caregiving spel leert sociale rollen; ambachtelijke technieken passeren tussen generaties. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Gegenaaide doek of verbergbal
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Voor industriële rubber, {civ} gemeenschappen in ZZCOUNRYZZ gevulde en genaaide ballen van huid, doek, of plantaardige vezels. Vang, schop, en cirkel games groeide rond deze objecten. De bal is net zo cultureel als de regels. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: Lokale spinning top vaartuigen
top_local.descTemplate: Top play is oeroude en globale; dit item registreert ZZCOUNTHERYZZ's {civ} carving stijlen, tip materialen, en wedstrijd etiquette als een aparte ambacht-en-spel praktijk binnen dat gedeelde natuurkunde speelgoed. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Lokale tekenreeksfiguren
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} string figuren gekoppeld aan ZZCOUNTHERYZZ dragen lokale namen, dieren en mythes zelfs wanneer openingen lijken op katten wieg elders. Deinclusive figuren zijn draagbare diagrammen van verhaal en handgeheugen. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Folk race board (lokaal)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Kruis-en-cirkel en pad raceborden verschijnen in vele landen. In ZZCOUNRYZZ gebruikten {civ} spelers schelpen, sticks of knucklebones om homecousins te racen naar pachisi-achtige structuren, maar met lokale trackvormen en safe-space gewoonten geregistreerd als een regionale folk race board. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Lokaal zaai Systeem
sowing_local.descTemplate: Waar zaaigames wortel haalden in {country}, tonen {civ} boards onderscheidend aantal bekers, relaisregels en houtvormen. Ze behoren tot de mancala familie maar verdienen regionale inzendingen wanneer de meetkunde en de vangst douane lokaal zijn gestandaardiseerd.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Kopplank of putjes in de aarde

jump_rope.title: Touwspellen overslaan
jump_rope.descTemplate: Skipping en jump-touw rijmen gedijen in de schoolpleinen en straten van {civ} jeugdcultuur. Solo snelheid stappen en groep lange-touw games delen het stuiterende ritme; gezangen lokaliseren het speelgoed. ({country}, {civ})
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Touw van hennep, kunststof of wijnstokprocent

blindfold_tag.title: Blind man's tag / call games · nl
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Blindfold op zoek naar spellen en call-and-dodge-varianten verschijnen tussen {civ}-partijen en kinderbijeenkomsten in ZZCOUNRYZZ. Geluid, stilte en empathie voor de verblinde speler structuur het plezier. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Volksworstelspel voor jongeren
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Jeugdworstelspellen bereiden zich Voorzitter voor op volwassen volksstijlen gevierd door {civ} gemeenschappen in {country}. Speel versies benadrukken veilige gooit, cirkel grenzen, en lachen over blessure spel als sociaal speelgoed.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Geheugennummer / eliminatiechant
memory_song.descTemplate: Eliminatie gezangen en geheugenliedjes die 'wie blijft' cirkelgames zijn speelgoed van ritme en aandacht in {civ} orale cultuur in ZZCOUNRYZZ. Verkeerde woorden of gemiste beats elimineren spelers totdat men blijft. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: palen en balanceerstokken
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilten verschijnen als festival tools en kinderbalance speelgoed in ZZCOUNRYZZ. {civ} makers heffen wandelaars op bamboe, hout of gerecycleerde blikken. Racing en trick-stepping zetten hoogte in spel. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: Blad- of schorsbootraces
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Miniatuur boot races met behulp van bladeren, schors, of maïskolven verrukking kinderen in de buurt van water in ZZCOUNRYZZ. {civ} play verandert stromingen in tracks en ambacht in engineering experimenten. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Bladeren, schors of kurk voor rompen

snow_or_sand.title: Zand / sneeuw figuur spelen
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Het beeldhouwen van tijdelijke figuren in zand of sneeuw is een elementair constructiespel waar {civ} landschappen in ZZCOUNRYZZ het medium leveren. Kastelen, dieren, en voorouderlijke vormen verschijnen en erode. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Tafelblad voetbal / papier voetbal
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick games die voetbal/voetbal simuleren op een tafelblad verspreid door scholen in {country}, gelaagd op oudere vinger-flicking speelgoed gewoonten in {civ} kindertijd. Doelen zijn boeken of getrokken posten; toernooien kunnen fel zijn.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Lokale raadseluitwisseling
riddle_local.descTemplate: Riddle uitwisselingen in {country} behouden {civ} metafoor, ecologie en humor. Poseren en oplossen onder tijdsdruk is een geest speeltje dat geen gefabriceerde apparatuur vereist.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Festival noisemaker speelgoed
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Festival noisemakers. Ratchets, klappers, klokkenstokjes. Laat kinderen deelnemen aan {civ} public rites in ZZCOUNRYZZ. Volume en ritme mark kalender tijd; sommige speelgoed zijn seizoensgebonden en daarna opgeslagen als rituele versnelling. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.

puzzle_knot.title: Koord & knoop puzzelspeeltje
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Disentanglement puzzels van koord, ringen en hout verschijnen als markt speelgoed en smid curiositeiten rond ZZCOUNRYZZ. {civ} spelers leren topologie door aanraking een ring vrij te geven zonder forceren, dan opnieuw in elkaar te zetten. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Miniatuur huishoudelijke spelen set
mini_house.descTemplate: Kleine huishoudgereedschappen Archevlekologie en etnografie vinden beide dit leerspeelgoed. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Grzebień dziecięcy
rattle.descTemplate: Grzechotniki należą do najstarszych zabawek dźwiękowych. W {country} opiekunowie {civ} mają długo zapieczętowane nasiona lub kamyki w gąszczu, gliny, koszykówki lub drewna, aby nagrodzić niemowlęcia chwytanie i rytm. Grzechotka jest zarówno sensoryczną zabawką i, w niektórych miejscach, dźwiękiem ochronnym.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Grzebień pustych z nasionami, kamykami lub dzwonkami

whistle_toy.title: Gwizdek z gliny lub drewna
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Małe gwizdki - glina w kształcie ptaka, rzeźbione drewno, trzcina - pojawiają się na rynkach i warstw archeologicznych związanych z życia {civ} w {country}. Dzieci używają ich jako zabawek wzmacniających głos; niektóre podwójne jako festiwalowe noisemakery. Gra dźwiękowa uczy oddychania i rzucania w sposób zabawny.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Animal pull toy · pl
pull_toy.descTemplate: Kołowe zwierzęta i pull- wzdłuż figur są udokumentowane z klasycznej starożytności poprzez wioskowe łodzie w {country}. {civ} rzemieślnicy kształtują konie, ptaki lub woły, które uczą pieszych maluchów o trakcji i towarzystwie w ruchu.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: Zestaw do zabawy z zabawkami
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Skalowane zabawki myśliwskie pozwalają dzieciom w {country} ćwiczyć umiejętności celebrowane przez dorosłych {civ} - łucznictwo, rzutki ciernia, lub dmuchawy cel - przy użyciu bezpieczniejszych materiałów. Cele na słomie, drewnie lub ingredirach, zamieniają technikę walki w grę punktową.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: Miękkie lub niskiej mocy zabawki łuk / rzutki

jacks_local.title: Kamienie kieszonkowe
jacks_local.descTemplate: Poza wspólną rodziną kostek kości, {country} posiada lokalne sekwencji umiejętności kamienne i nasienne ukształtowane przez {civ} dzieciństwo - różne rzuty, pieśni i drabiny trudności na tej samej zasadzie pickup, rejestrowane tutaj jako regionalne wejście praktyki, gdy pieśni i sekwencje są lokalnie odrębne.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Gry Story loss / losowanie losów gry
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Na spotkaniach {civ} w {country} pojawiają się partie odlewnicze na obroty, przepadki lub podpowiedzi. Czy bambusowe pałeczki, kostki, czy malowane kości, szansa wybiera kto mówi, tańczy, czy odpowiada - zabawka towarzyska na skraju division i gra partyjna.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Liczby cieni grają
shadow_play.descTemplate: Gra cieni - zwierzęta ręczne lub skórzane marionetki - zabawiała noce w {country} w ramach {civ} opowiadania historii. Światło i sylwetka zamieniają gest w teatr. Niektóre regiony podniosły to do formalnych sztuk marionetek; cienie rąk dzieci pozostają zabawką.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Lokalne statki latające
kite_local.descTemplate: Podczas gdy latawiec latanie jest jedną globalną rodziną, {country} 's {civ} twórców opracował charakterystyczne kształty, papiery, bringle i wykorzystanie festiwalu. Wpis ten podkreśla, że miejscowa tradycja rzemiosła jako regionalnej praktyki latawca pod szerszym latawcem nieba.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Lokalna lalka tkacka
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Miękkie lalki ubrane w lokalne wzory włókiennicze pojawiają się w domach {civ} w {country}. Hafty, odzież, i fryzury miniaturyzuj strój dorosłych. Pielęgniarka uczy się w roli społecznej, a fachowcy przechodzą przez pokolenia.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Szyte tkaniny lub kulka do ukrycia
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Przed gumą przemysłową, społeczności {civ} w {country} wypchane i szyte kulki z skóry, tkaniny lub włókna roślinnego. Catch, kopnięcie i kółko gry rosły wokół tych obiektów. Piłka jest tak kulturowa jak zasady.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Szyte tkaniny, palma lub kulka do ukrycia

top_local.title: Lokalne wirujące górne jednostki pływające
top_local.descTemplate: Najlepsza gra jest starożytna i globalna; ten wpis nagrywa {country} 's style rzeźbiarskie {civ}, materiały napiwkowe, i etykiety konkursu jako odrębna rzemiosło i gra praktyka w ramach tej wspólnej zabawki fizyki.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Lokalne liczby łańcuchowe
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} postaci smyczkowe związane z {country} noszą lokalne nazwy, zwierzęta i mity, nawet jeśli otwory przypominają kolebkę kota gdzie indziej. Liczby to przenośne diagramy historii i pamięci ręcznej.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Płyta wyścigowa ludowa (lokalna)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Na wielu ziemiach pojawiają się krzyże i krąg oraz deski wyścigowe. W {country} gracze {civ} używali muszli, pałeczek lub kostek do wyścigów markerów do domu - kuzyni pachisi- podobne struktury, ale z lokalnych kształtów toru i bezpieczne przestrzenne zwyczaje rejestrowane jako regionalnej rady wyścigu ludowego.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Lokalny siew nasion i nasion
sowing_local.descTemplate: Gdzie siew gry miał korzenie w {country}, płyty {civ} wykazują charakterystyczne liczby pucharów, zasady przekazywania, i kształty drewna. Należą one do rodziny mancalów, ale zasługują na wpisy regionalne, gdy geometria planszy i zwyczaje przechwytywania są lokalnie standaryzowane.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Płyty kubełkowe lub doły w ziemi

jump_rope.title: Pominięcie gry liny
jump_rope.descTemplate: Przeskakiwanie i jump-liny rymy rozwijają się w {country} szkolnych i ulic w {civ} kultury dzieciństwa. Pojedyncze kroki prędkości i grupy Long- line gry akcji rytm odbijania; pieśni zlokalizować zabawki.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Lina konopi, tworzyw sztucznych lub winorośli

blindfold_tag.title: Blind man 's tag / call games
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Blindfolded gry poszukujące - opcje call- and- dodge - pojawiają się na wszystkich {civ} stron i zebrania dzieci w {country}. Dźwięk, spokój i empatia dla niewidomego gracza struktury zabawy.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Folk wrestling play for youth
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Gry młodzieżowe wrestling przygotować dla dorosłych stylów ludowych obchodzone przez społeczności {civ} w {country}. Zagraj wersje podkreślają bezpieczne rzuty, okrągłe granice i śmiech nad kontuzją - sport jako zabawka społeczna.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Pieśń pamięci / śpiew eliminacji
memory_song.descTemplate: Piosenki eliminacyjne i utwory pamięci - podobne do "kto pozostaje" gry okrągłe - są zabawkami rytmu i uwagi w ZZCIVPopatrz kultury ustnej w {country}. Złe słowa lub nieodebrane uderzenia eliminują graczy, aż jeden pozostaje ({civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Sztaby lub słupy wyważające
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Tweet Tweet Producenci {civ} hodują wędrowców na bambusie, drewnie lub puszkach z recyklingu. Racing i trick-stepping włączyć elewacji do gry. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: Para szczotki lub puszki do żucia

leaf_boat.title: Liście lub wyścigi łodzi kory
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Miniaturowe wyścigi łodzi z wykorzystaniem liści, kory lub kolby kukurydzy zachwycają dzieci w pobliżu wody w {country}. {civ} gra zamienia prądy w tory i rzemiosło w eksperymenty inżynieryjne.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Liście, kora lub korek do kadłubów

snow_or_sand.title: Piasek / śnieg gra figurowa
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Rzeźbiarstwo tymczasowych figur w piasku lub śniegu jest elementarną grą budowlaną wszędzie tam, gdzie krajobraz {civ} zapewnia medium. Pojawiają się zamki, zwierzęta i formy rodowe - architektura jako efemeryczna zabawka. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Piłka nożna / piłka nożna w postaci papieru
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick gry, które symulują piłkę nożną / piłkę nożną na stole rozłożone przez szkoły w {country}, ułożone na starszych stykających się z palców nawyków zabawki w {civ} dzieciństwa. Cele są książki lub ciągnięte posty; turnieje mogą być gwałtowne.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Lokalna wymiana zagadek
riddle_local.descTemplate: Riddle wymiany w {country} zachować {civ} metafora, ekologia, i humor. Pozowanie i rozwiązywanie pod presją czasu jest zabawką dla umysłu, która nie wymaga produkcji sprzętu.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Festiwal noisemaker zabawki
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Festiwal noisemakers - zapadki, klapy, bell- kije - niech dzieci dołączą do {civ} publicznych obrzędów w {country}. Czas trwania kalendarza głośności i rytmu; niektóre zabawki są sezonowe i przechowywane po nim, jak narzędzia rytualne.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.

puzzle_knot.title: Cord & węzeł puzzle zabawki
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: DyentanglePokażę zagadki sznura, pierścieni i drewna jako zabawki rynkowe i ciekawostki kowala wokół {country}. {civ} gracze uczą się topologii dotykiem - wydać pierścień bez wymuszania, a następnie ponownie złożyć.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Zestaw do zabawy dla gospodarstw domowych miniaturowych
mini_house.descTemplate: Małe narzędzia gospodarstwa domowego - patelnie gliniane, maty tkane, meble do lalek - wspieranie ról dorosłego życia domowego w dzieciństwie {civ} w {country}. Archeologia i etnografia znajdują te zabawki.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Infant rattle · sv
rattle.descTemplate: Rattles är bland de äldsta ljudleksakerna. I {country}, {civ} vårdgivare har länge förseglade frön eller stenar i gourd, lera, korg eller trä för att belöna spädbarn grepp och rytm. Råttan är både sensorisk leksak och på vissa ställen ett skyddande charmljud ({civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Hollow rattle med frön, stenar eller klockor

whistle_toy.title: Clay eller trä whistle leksak
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Små visselpipor - fågelformad lera, snidat trä, reed - visas på marknader och arkeologiska lager bundna till {civ} liv i {country}. Barn använder dem som röstförstärkande leksaker; några dubbla som festivalbuller. Ljudspel lär andetag och pitch lekfullt.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Djur pull leksak
pull_toy.descTemplate: Hjulen djur och drag-långa figurer dokumenteras från klassisk antiken genom byns träfarkoster i {country}. {civ} hantverkare formar hästar, fåglar eller oxar som undervisar gå småbarn om drag och sällskap i rörelse.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: Toy bow eller dart play set
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Skalade jaktleksaker låter barn i {country} repetera färdigheter som firas av {civ}-vuxna - bågskytte, spear-thorn darts eller blowpipe mål - med säkrare material. Mål på halm, trä eller dragna cirklar förvandlar kampsportteknik till poängterad lek.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: Mjuk eller låg effekt leksak Båg / Darts

jacks_local.title: Pocket skicklighet stenar
jacks_local.descTemplate: Beyond the shared knucklebones family, {country} has local stone-and-seed skill sequences shaped by {civ} childhood—different throws, chants, and difficulty ladders on the same pickup principle, recorded here as a regional practice entry when chants and sequences are locally distinct.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Story lots / ritning lots spel
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Casting lots för varv, förverkande, eller story prompts visas i {civ} samlingar i {country}Z. Oavsett om bambu sticks, knucklebones eller målade tärningar, väljer chansen vem som talar, dansar eller svar - en social leksak i utkanten av spådom och festspel ({civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Skuggfigurer spelar
shadow_play.descTemplate: Shadow play-hand djur eller läder marionetter-har underhållna nätter i {country} inom {civ} storytelling. Ljus och silhuett förvandla gesten till teater. Vissa regioner förhöjde detta i formell marionettkonst; barns handskuggor förblir leksaksformen ({civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Lokala kite hantverk
kite_local.descTemplate: Medan kite flygning är en global familj, {country} {civ} tillverkare utvecklade distinkta former, papper, brudar och festival användningsområden. Detta inlägg belyser att lokal hantverkstradition som en regional kite praxis under den bredare kite himlen ({civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Local cloth Doll
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Mjuka dockor klädda i lokala textilmönster visas över {civ} hushåll i {country}. Broderi, wrap kläder och frisyrer miniaturize vuxenklänning. Caregiving play lär sociala roller; hantverkstekniker passerar mellan generationer ({civ})
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Sög tyg eller göm boll
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Innan industrigummi, {civ} samhällen i {country} fyllda och sydda bollar från göm, tyg eller växtfiber. Fånga, sparka och cirkelspel växte runt dessa objekt. Bollens make är lika kulturellt som reglerna. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Sög tyg, palm eller göm bollen

top_local.title: Lokal spinning top craft
top_local.descTemplate: Top play is ancient and global; this entry records {country}'s {civ} carving styles, tip materials, and contest etiquette as a distinct craft-and-play practice within that shared physics toy.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Lokala strängsiffror
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} strängfigurer kopplade till {country} bär lokala namn, djur och myter även när öppningar liknar kattens vagga någon annanstans. Siffrorna är bärbara diagram av historia och handminne. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Folk race board (lokal)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Kors-och-cirkel och stig ras styrelser visas i många länder. I {country} använde {civ}-spelare skal, pinnar eller knucklebones för att tävla markörer hem-kusiner till pachisi-liknande strukturer men med lokala spårformer och säker rymdtull registrerad som en regional folktävlingsbräda ({civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Lokal pit-and-seed sowing
sowing_local.descTemplate: Där sådd spel tog rot i {country}, {civ} styrelser visar distinkta koppräkningar, reläregler och trä former. De tillhör familjen mancala men förtjänar regionala poster när styrelsegeometri och fånga tullen är lokalt standardiserade ({civ})
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Cup board eller gropar på jorden

jump_rope.title: Skipping Rope spel
jump_rope.descTemplate: Hoppa och hoppa-rep rim trivs i {country} skolgårdar och gator inom {civ} barndomskultur. Solo speed steps och grupp long-rope spel delar den studsande rytmen; chants lokalisera leksaken.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Rope av hampa, plast eller vin

blindfold_tag.title: Blind mans tag / call games
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Blindfolded söker spel-call-and-dodge varianter-uppträder över {civ}-partier och barnsamlingar i {country}. Ljud, stillhet och empati för den blinda spelarstrukturen det roliga ({civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Folk brottning lek för ungdomar
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Ungdomsbrottningsspel förbereder sig för vuxna folkstilar som firas av {civ}-samhällen i {country}. Spela versioner betonar säkra kast, cirkelgränser och skratt över skada-sport som social leksak ({civ})
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Memory sång / elimination chant
memory_song.descTemplate: Elimineringssånger och minnessånger - som liknar "vem som återstår" cirkelspel - är leksaker av rytm och uppmärksamhet i {civ} oral kultur i {country}. Fel ord eller missade slag eliminerar spelare tills man är kvar ({civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Stilts eller balans poler
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts visas som festivalverktyg och barns balansleksaker i {country}. {civ} tillverkare höjer vandrare på bambu, trä eller återvunna burkar. Racing och trick-stepping förvandlar höjden till spel.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: Pair of stilts eller tin-can stilts

leaf_boat.title: Leaf eller bark båt racing
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Miniatyrbåt raser med hjälp av löv, bark eller corncobs glädje barn nära vatten i {country}Z. {civ} spelar förvandlar strömmar till spår och hantverk till tekniska experiment.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Lämnar, bark eller kork för skrov

snow_or_sand.title: Sand / Snö Siffra
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Skulpterande tillfälliga figurer i sand eller snö är elementärt byggspel där {civ} landskap i {country} ger mediet. Slott, djur och förfäder framträder och eroderar - arkitektur som efemäral leksak ({civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Tabell flick fotboll / papper fotboll
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flicka spel som simulerar fotboll / fotboll på en bordsskiva sprids genom skolor i {country}, lagt på äldre finger-flicking leksaksvanor i {civ} barndom. Mål är böcker eller dragna inlägg; turneringar kan vara hårda ({civ})
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Local riddle Exchange
riddle_local.descTemplate: Riddle utbyten i {country} bevara {civ} metafor, ekologi och humor. Posera och lösa under tidspress är en sinnesleksak som kräver ingen tillverkad utrustning ({civ})
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Festival buller toy
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Festivalbuller - ratchets, clappers, bell-sticks - låt barn gå {civ} offentliga riter i {country}. Volym och rytm markerar kalendertiden; vissa leksaker är säsongsbetonade och lagras efteråt som rituella redskap ({civ})
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, bell stick, clapper eller trumleksak

puzzle_knot.title: Cord & knot pusselleksak
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Disentanglement pussel av sladd, ringar och trä verkar som marknadsleksaker och blacksmith nyfikenheter runt {country}. {civ}-spelare lär sig topologi genom beröring - släpp en ring utan att tvinga, sedan montera.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.

Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Miniatyr hushållsspel
mini_house.descTemplate: Små hushållsverktyg - lera pannor, vävda mattor, dockmöbler - stödja rollspel av vuxen inhemskt liv i {civ} barndomar i {country}Z. Arkeologi och etnografi hittar båda dessa leksaker ({civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Βρέφος κροταλίας
rattle.descTemplate: Οι κροτάλες είναι από τα παλαιότερα ηχητικά παιχνίδια. Στο {country}, οι φροντιστές του {civ} έχουν μακρού σφραγισμένους σπόρους ή βότσαλα σε κολοκύθα, πηλό, καλαθοπλεκτική ή ξύλο για να ανταμείψουν το νήπιο και το ρυθμό. Η κουδουνίστρα είναι τόσο αισθητηριακή παιχνίδι και, σε ορισμένα μέρη, μια προστατευτική γοητεία ήχο.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
