Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Κοίλη κροταλία με σπόρους, βότσαλα ή καμπάνες

whistle_toy.title: Παιχνίδι σφύριξης από άργιλο ή ξύλο
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Μικρές σφυρίχτρες—πουλιά σε σχήμα πηλού, σκαλιστό ξύλο, καλάμι— εμφανίζονται σε αγορές και αρχαιολογικά στρώματα που συνδέονται με τη ζωή {civ} σε {country}. Τα παιδιά τα χρησιμοποιούν ως παιχνίδια που ενθουσιάζουν τη φωνή, μερικά διπλά σαν ηχητικούς του φεστιβάλ. Το ηχητικό παιχνίδι διδάσκει αναπνοή και πίσσα παιχνιδιάρικα.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Παιχνίδι έλξης ζώων
pull_toy.descTemplate: Τα τροχοφόρα ζώα και οι πορφυρές μορφές τεκμηριώνονται από την κλασική αρχαιότητα μέσω των ξυλοτεχνημάτων του χωριού στο {country}. Οι τεχνίτες {civ} διαμορφώνουν άλογα, πουλιά ή βόδια που διδάσκουν περιπατητικά νήπια σχετικά με την έλξη και τη συντροφιά σε κίνηση.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: Σύνολο παιχνιδιών με τόξο ή βελάκια
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Η κλιμάκωση των κυνηγετικών παιχνιδιών επιτρέπει στα παιδιά να συμμετέχουν στις πρόβες {country} που γιορτάζουν οι ενήλικες {civ}—αρχεία, βελάκια λόγχης, ή στόχος φυσητήρα— χρησιμοποιώντας ασφαλέστερα υλικά. Οι στόχοι σε άχυρο, ξύλο ή σύρσιμο κύκλους μετατρέπουν την πολεμική τεχνική σε σκοράρισμα.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: Πέτρες για επιδεξιότητες τσέπης
jacks_local.descTemplate: Πέρα από την κοινή οικογένεια των αρθρώσεων, η {country} έχει τοπικές ακολουθίες δεξιοτήτων πέτρας και σπόρου που διαμορφώνονται από την παιδική ηλικία {civ}—διαφορετικές throwψεις, ψαλμωδίες, και σκάλες δυσκολίας στην ίδια αρχή pickup, καταγράφονται εδώ ως μια περιφερειακή είσοδο πρακτική, όταν τα άσματα και οι ακολουθίες είναι τοπικά διακριτές.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Ιστορία παρτίδες / σχέδιο παρτίδα παιχνίδι
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Η Castψη των παρτίδων για στροφές, καταπτώσεις, ή παρακλήσεις ιστορία εμφανίζεται σε συγκεντρώσεις {civ} στο {country}. Είτε μπαμπού ραβδιά, αρθρωτήρες, είτε ζωγραφισμένα ζάρια, η τύχη επιλέγει ποιος μιλάει, χορεύει, ή απαντήσεις—ένα κοινωνικό παιχνίδι στην άκρη της μαντείας και παιχνίδι κόμμα.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Shadow figures play
shadow_play.descTemplate: Σκιώδη παιχνίδια— ζώα με το χέρι ή μαριονέτες leather έχει διασκεδάσει νύχτες στο {country} μέσα {civ} αφήγηση. Το φως και η σιλουέτα μετατρέπουν τη χειρονομία σε θέατρο. Ορισμένες περιοχές το ανέβασαν σε επίσημες μαριονέτες· οι σκιές στα χέρια των παιδιών παραμένουν η μορφή παιχνιδιού.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Τοπικό σκάφος χαρταετού
kite_local.descTemplate: Ενώ το kite adverse είναι μια παγκόσμια οικογένεια, οι κατασκευαστές {country} του ανέπτυξαν διακριτικά σχήματα, χαρτιά, χαλινάρια και χρήσεις φεστιβάλ. Αυτό το λήμμα τονίζει ότι η τοπική βιοτεχνία παράδοση ως μια περιφερειακή πρακτική χαρταετού κάτω από τον ευρύτερο ουρανό χαρταετού ({civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Τοπική κούκλα με ύφασμα
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Μαλακές κούκλες ντυμένες με τοπικά σχέδια υφασμάτων εμφανίζονται στα νοικοκυριά {civ} στο {country}. Κεντ Ottomans, περιτύλιξη ρούχα, και χτενίσματα miniaturize φόρεμα ενηλίκων. Το παιχνίδι της φροντίδας διδάσκει κοινωνικούς ρόλους.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Ράψιμο υφάσματος ή τριχώματος
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Πριν από το βιομηχανικό καουτσούκ, οι κοινότητες {civ} σε {country} γεμιστές και sewμμένα μπάλες από δέρμα, ύφασμα ή φυτικές ίνες. Πιάσε, κλωτσιά, και κυκλικά παιχνίδια μεγάλωσε γύρω από αυτά τα Milanos. Η μπάλα είναι τόσο πολιτιστική όσο οι κανόνες.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Ράβδοι, φοίνικες ή σφαιρίδια για την απόκρυψη

top_local.title: Τοπικό σκάφος περιστροφής
top_local.descTemplate: Top play is ancient and global; this entry records {country}'s {civ} carving styles, tip materials, and contest etiquette as a distinct craft-and-play practice within that shared physics toy.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Τοπικά αριθμητικά στοιχεία
string_local.descTemplate: Τα αριθμητικά Topics {civ} που συνδέονται με το {country} φέρουν τοπικά ονόματα, ζώα και μύθους ακόμη και όταν τα ανοίγματα μοιάζουν με το λίκνο της γάτας αλλού. Οι αριθμοί είναι φορητά διαγράμματα ιστορίας και μνήμης χεριών.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Πίνακας λαϊκών αγώνων (τοπικό)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Διασταυρωμένοι Θαλαμίσκοι Αγώνα και Πορείας εμφανίζονται σε πολλές χώρες. Στο {country}, οι παίκτες της {civ} χρησιμοποίησαν κοχύλια, ραβδιά, ή Wishbones για να αγωνιστούν στο σπίτι-κουζίνες για να pachisi-όπως δομές, αλλά με τοπικά σχήματα στίβου και το ασφαλές-διαστημικό έθιμα που καταγράφονται ως μια περιφερειακή λαϊκή πίνακα αγώνων.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Τοπική σπορά ελαιούχων φοινίκων
sowing_local.descTemplate: Εκεί που τα παιχνίδια σποράς ρίζωσαν στο {country}, οι πίνακες {civ} παρουσιάζουν διακριτές μετρήσεις κυπέλλου, κανόνες ρελέ και σχήματα ξύλου. Ανήκουν στην οικογένεια Mancala αλλά αξίζουν περιφερειακές εγγραφές όταν η γεωμετρία του σκάφους και η σύλληψη των τελωνείων είναι τοπικά τυποποιημένες.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: Παράλειψη παιχνιδιών με σχοινί
jump_rope.descTemplate: Οι ομοιοκαταληξίες του {country} ευδοκιμούν στις σχολικές αυλές και στους δρόμους μέσα στην παιδική κουλτούρα του {civ}. Τα σόλο βήματα ταχύτητας και τα ομαδικά παιχνίδια μεγάλου μήκους μοιράζονται το ρυθμό αναπήδησης.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: Ετικέτα τυφλού / call games
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Τυφλοί αναζητούν παιχνίδια - call-and-dodge παραλλαγές-εμφανίζονται σε {civ} κόμματα και παιδικές συγκεντρώσεις σε {country}. Ήχος, ακινησία και συμπάθεια για τον τυφλό παίκτη δομή τη διασκέδαση.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Η λαϊκή πάλη παίζει για τη νεολαία
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Νεανική πάλη παιχνίδια προετοιμασία για ενήλικες λαϊκά στυλ που γιορτάζονται από τις κοινότητες {civ} σε {country}. Παίξτε εκδόσεις τονίζουν ασφαλείς throwψεις, τα όρια του κύκλου, και το γέλιο πάνω από τραυματισμό—αθλητισμός ως κοινωνικό παιχνίδι.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Τραγούδι μνήμης / τραγούδι εξάλειψης
memory_song.descTemplate: Απομάκρυνση ψαλμωδίες και τραγούδια μνήμης— akin σε 'ποιος παραμένει' παιχνίδια κύκλου— είναι παιχνίδια ρυθμού και προσοχής στην προφορική κουλτούρα {civ} στο {country}. Λάθος λέξεις ή χαμένους ρυθμούς εξαλείφουν τους παίκτες μέχρι να παραμείνει ένας.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Στιλβώματα ή κοντάρια ζυγοστάθμισης
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Τα ξυλοπόδαρα εμφανίζονται ως εργαλεία φεστιβάλ και παιδικά παιχνίδια ισορροπίας στο {country}. Οι κατασκευαστές {civ} αυξάνουν τους περιπατητές σε μπαμπού, ξύλο ή ανακυκλωμένα δοχεία. Αγωνιστικά και τρικ-βήμα μετατρέπουν την ανύψωση σε παιχνίδι.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: Κυλιόμενες βάρκες με φύλλα ή γαβγίσματα
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Μινιατούρα καραβιών αγώνες χρησιμοποιώντας φύλλα, φλοιό, ή καλαμπόκια απολαμβάνουν τα παιδιά κοντά στο νερό σε {country}. Το παιχνίδι {civ} μετατρέπει τα ρεύματα σε κομμάτια και βιοτεχνία σε πειράματα μηχανικής.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Φύλλα, φλοιός ή φελλός για το κύτος

snow_or_sand.title: Άμμος / παιχνίδι φιγούρας χιονιού
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Γλυπτική προσωρινή στοιχεία στην άμμο ή το χιόνι είναι στοιχειώδης κατασκευή παιχνίδι όπου {civ} τοπία σε {country} παρέχουν το μέσο. Κάστρα, ζώα και προγονικές μορφές εμφανίζονται και διαβρώνουν—αρχιτεκτονική ως εφήμερο παιχνίδι.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Ποδόσφαιρο / χάρτινο ποδόσφαιρο
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick παιχνίδια που προσομοιώνουν το ποδόσφαιρο / το ποδόσφαιρο σε μια επιτραπέζια κορυφή εξαπλωθεί μέσω των σχολείων σε {country}, στρώνεται σε παλιότερες finger-flicking συνήθειες παιχνιδιών στην παιδική ηλικία {civ}. Οι στόχοι είναι βιβλία ή σχεδιασμένες θέσεις; τουρνουά μπορεί να είναι άγρια.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Τοπική ανταλλαγή αινιγμάτων
riddle_local.descTemplate: Οι αινιγματικές ανταλλαγές στο {country} διατηρούν τη μεταφορά {civ}, την οικολογία και το χιούμορ. Η πόζα και η επίλυση υπό πίεση χρόνου είναι ένα παιχνίδι μυαλού που απαιτεί μη κατασκευασμένο εξοπλισμό.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Παιχνίδι με θορυβοποιό φεστιβάλ
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Οι ηχοποιοί του φεστιβάλ—παξιμάδια, παλαμάκια, κουδούνια— αφήνουν τα παιδιά να συμμετάσχουν στις δημόσιες τελετές του {civ} στο {country}. Ο όγκος και ο ρυθμός σημειώνουν το ημερολογιακό χρόνο · μερικά παιχνίδια είναι εποχιακά και αποθηκεύονται κατόπιν σαν τελετουργικά εργαλεία.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ράτσετ, κωδωνοστάσιο, παλαμάκι ή τύμπανο παιχνίδι

puzzle_knot.title: Παιχνίδι παζλ & κόμπος
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Τα ξεμπερδέματα από κορδόνια, δαχτυλίδια και ξύλο εμφανίζονται ως παιχνίδια της αγοράς και περιτομές σιδηρουργών γύρω από το {country}. Οι παίκτες της {civ} μαθαίνουν τοπολογία μέσω αφής—απελευθερώστε ένα δαχτυλίδι χωρίς να πιέσετε, στη συνέχεια επανασυναρμολογήστε.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Σετ μινιατούρας οικιακού παιχνιδιού
mini_house.descTemplate: Μικροσκοπικά οικιακά εργαλεία— παν hat, υφασμένα χαλάκια, έπιπλα κούκλας— υποστήριξη roleόλων της οικογενειακής ζωής ενηλίκων στην παιδική ηλικία {civ} σε {country}. Η αρχαιολογία και η εθνογραφία βρίσκουν αυτά τα διδακτικά παιχνίδια.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.
req: Γλάστρες, χαλάκια ή κούκλες για μικροσκοπικά είδη

rattle.title: תינוק
rattle.descTemplate: ריבים הם בין הצעצועים העתיקים ביותר. ב ZZCOUNTIZZ, {civ} מטפלים יש זרעים חתמים ארוכים או bbles ב gourd, חימר, סלרי, או עץ כדי לתגמל תינוקות תופסים וקצב. הקרטל הוא גם צעצוע חושי וגם, במקומות מסוימים, צליל קסם מגן. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: הוולו רועד עם זרעים, pebbles, או פעמונים

whistle_toy.title: קליי או Wood whistle צעצוע
whistle_toy.descTemplate: שרטוטים קטנים – עץ חימר בצורת ציפורי, מגולף – מתפוגג בשווקים ושכבות ארכיאולוגיות הקשורות לחיי {civ} ב- ZZCOUN Travel. ילדים משתמשים בהם כצעצועי קולות; חלקם כפולים כמו יוצרי רעש. משחק סאונד מלמד נשימה וחתיכה. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: בעלי חיים מושכים צעצוע
pull_toy.descTemplate: בעלי חיים ודמויות מושכים מתועדות מהעת העתיקה הקלאסית דרך מחסני הכפר ב-ZZCOUNTimeZZ. {civ} artisans מעצב סוסים, ציפורים, או oxen אשר מלמדים פעוטות הליכה על מערכת יחסים ושותפות בתנועה. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: צעצוע קשת או Dart Play
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: צעצועי ציד בקנה מידה מאפשרים לילדים ב-ZZCOUNZZ rehearse מיומנויות שנחגגות על ידי {civ} מבוגרים - archery, spear-thorn darts, או המטרה של Blowpipe - שימוש בחומרים בטוחים יותר. מטרות על קש, עץ, או מעגלים נמשכים הופכות לטכניקה צבאית למשחק הבקיע. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: רך או נמוך כוח צעצוע קשת / רעידות

jacks_local.title: אבני מיומנות Pocket
jacks_local.descTemplate: מעבר למשפחה המשותפת של knucklebones, ZZCOUNTIZZ יש רצף מיומנות מקומי של אבן ו מזוקק עוצב על ידי {civ} ילדות - זריקות אחרות, מזמורים, וקשיים על אותו עיקרון איסוף, נרשם כאן כמבוא אזורי כאשר מזמורים ורצף הם נפרדים באופן מקומי. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: סיפור גדול / לצייר הרבה משחק
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: הקצאות רבות לסיבובים, זיוף, או הודעות סיפור מופיעים במפגשי {civ} ב- ZZCOUNTimeZZ. בין אם מקלות במבוק, knucklebones, או צופי צבוע, הזדמנות לבחור מי מדבר, רוקד או תשובות - צעצוע חברתי בקצה של תגליות ומשחקי צד. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: דמויות הצללים
shadow_play.descTemplate: משחקי צל - חיות יד או בובות עור - מבדרות לילות ב ZZCOUNTravelZZ בתוך {civ} Story. אור וסלומט הופכים למחווה לתיאטרון. אזורים מסוימים העלו את זה לאומנויות בובות רשמיות; צלי היד של הילדים נשארים הצורה הצעצועית. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: אמנות מקומית
kite_local.descTemplate: בעוד ערכות מעופפות היא משפחה גלובלית אחת, יצרני {civ} של {civ} פיתחו צורות ייחודיות, ניירות, ריבים ושימושי פסטיבל. כניסה זו מדגישה כי מסורת מלאכה מקומית כפרקטיקה אזורית תחת השמיים הרחבים יותר. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: תגית: doll
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: בובות רך לבושות בדפוסי טקסטיל מקומיים מופיעים ברחבי משקי הבית של {civ} ב ZZCOUNTimeZZ. רקמות, עוטפים בגדים, תסרוקות מקטנות את השמלה למבוגרים. משחק זהירות מלמד תפקידים חברתיים; טכניקות מלאכה עוברות בין הדורות. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: מטלית או מסתירה כדור
ball_sewn.descTemplate: לפני גומי תעשייתי, {civ} קהילות ב- ZZCOUNtry דחוס ותפירה כדורים ממחבוא, בד או סיבי צמח. לתפוס, לבעוט ומשחקי מעגל גדלו סביב חפצים אלה. יצירת הכדור היא תרבותית כמו הכללים. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: מטלית, כף יד, או כיסוי כדור

top_local.title: כלי שיט מקומיים
top_local.descTemplate: משחק Top הוא עתיק וגלובאלי; כניסה זו מתעדת את סגנונות {civ} של {civ}, חומרי טיפ, תחרות etique כפרקטיקה ייחודית-and-play בתוך צעצוע פיזי משותף זה. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: דמויות מחרוזת מקומיות
string_local.descTemplate: נתוני {civ} המקושרים ל- ZZCOUN TravelZZ נושאים שמות מקומיים, בעלי חיים ומיתוסים גם כאשר פתחים דומים לצלב החתול במקום אחר. הנתונים הם דיאגרמות ניידות של סיפור וזיכרון יד. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: לוח גזע עממי (local)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: לוחות מרוץ קרוס-וצלב וכביש מופיעים במדינות רבות. ב- ZZCOUNTIZZ, {civ} משתמשים בפגזים, מקלות, או knucklebones כדי גזע סמנים הביתה -cousins to pachisi - מבנים דמויי pachisi, אבל עם צורות מסלולים מקומיות ומכסים מאובטחים מרחביים שנרשמו כלוח גזע אזורי. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: שם מקור: and-seed sowing
sowing_local.descTemplate: בעוד משחקים sowing לקחו שורש ב ZZCOUNTravelzz, {civ} לוחות להראות ספירות גביע ייחודיות, חוקי המס וצורות עץ. הם שייכים למשפחת Mancala אך ראויים לערכים אזוריים כאשר גיאומטריה לוחית ומנהגי לכידת הם סטנדרטיים מקומית. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: משחקי חבל
jump_rope.descTemplate: דלג וקפוץ rope rhymes לשגשג בחצרות בית הספר של {civ} בתוך תרבות ילדות ZZ. מדרגות מהירות סולו ומשחקים ארוכי טווח קבוצתיים חולקים את קצב הקפיצה; מזמורים מקומיים להפוך את צעצוע. ({country}, {civ})
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Rope of Hemp, פלסטיק או חומץ

blindfold_tag.title: תגית: Blind Man's tag
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: משחקים דמויי עיניים – גרסאות קריאה-ודודג' – מסתיימים במסיבות {civ} ומפגשי ילדים ב-ZZCOUNTimeZZ. סאונד, צניעות ואמפתיה לשחקן העיוור מעצבים את הכיף. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: משחק עממי לנוער
wrestling_play.descTemplate: משחקי היאבקות לנוער נערכים לסגנונות עממיים למבוגרים שנחגגו על ידי קהילות ZZCIV ב ZZCOUNTimeZZ. גרסאות משחק מדגישות זריקה בטוחה, גבולות מעגל וצחוק על פציעה - ספורט כמו צעצוע חברתי. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: שיר זיכרון / חיסול
memory_song.descTemplate: מזמורי חיסול ושירי זיכרון - מיועדים למשחקי מעגל "מי נשאר" - הם צעצועים של קצב ותשומת לב בתרבות הפה של {civ}. מילים שגויות או פספסו את השחקנים עד שאחד מהם נשאר. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: מדרגות או מאזן
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts מופיעים ככלי פסטיבל וצעצועי איזון של ילדים ב ZZCOUNTravelzz. יצרני {civ} מעלים את ההולכים במבוק, עץ, או פחיות ממוחזרות. מירוץ וטיול טריק הופכים את הגובה למשחק. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: [he] Pair of stilts or tin-can stilts

leaf_boat.title: Leaf or bark Boat Racing
leaf_boat.descTemplate: מיניאטורי סירות מרוץ באמצעות עלים, דיו, או קרניים מענגים ילדים ליד מים ב ZZCOUNTIZZ. משחק {civ} הופך את הזרמים לתוך מסלולים ומלאכות בניסויים הנדסיים. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: [he] Leaves, bark, or cork for hulls

snow_or_sand.title: חול / שלג
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: פיסול דמויות זמניות בחול או שלג הוא משחק בנייה אלמנטרי בכל מקום בו נופים {civ} ב ZZCOUNZZ מספקים את המדיום.  Castles, בעלי חיים וצורות אסטרליות מופיעות ו-erode - architecture as ephemeral toy. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: טבלה flickball / נייר כדורגל
knuckle_football.descTemplate: משחקי Flick המדמיינים כדורגל/כדורגל על שולחן מתפשטים באמצעות בתי ספר ב- {country}, השכבה על הרגלי צעצוע של אצבע ישנים יותר בילדות {civ}. מטרות הן ספרים או קטעי וידאו; טורנירים יכולים להיות קשים.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: חילופי פאזלים מקומיים
riddle_local.descTemplate: חילופי רידל ב-ZZCOUNTIZZ משמרים את המטאפורה של ZZIVZZ, אקולוגיה והומור. אפשרות ופתרון תחת לחץ זמן הוא צעצוע נפשי הדורש לא ציוד מיוצר. ({country}, {civ})
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: פסטיבל רעש צעצוע
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: יוצרי רעש פסטיבלים - רכיטים, קלפינים, מקלפי פעמון - יאפשרו לילדים להצטרף לטקסים הציבוריים של {civ} ב- ZZCOUNTimeZZ. נפח וקצב מציינים זמן לוח שנה; כמה צעצועים הם עונתיים ומאוחסנים לאחר מכן כמו הילוכים טקסיים. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, פעמון מקל, clapper, או צעצוע תופים

puzzle_knot.title: תגיות קשורות Cord & Puppet
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: חידות סבוכות של טבורי, טבעות ועץ מופיעים כצעצועים בשוק ושרידים שחורים סביב ZZCOUNTimezz. שחקני {civ} לומדים טופולוגיה על ידי מגע - לשחרר טבעת ללא צורך, ואז להרכיב מחדש. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: משחק מיניאטורי
mini_house.descTemplate: כלים ביתיים זעירים - פאננטליים, הזדווגים ארוגים, ריהוט בוב - תמיכה משחק תפקידים של חיים מקומיים מבוגרים ב {civ} ילדות ב ZZCOUNTravel. הארכיאולוגיה והאתנוגרף מוצאים את הצעצועים האלה. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Непристойна гра
rattle.descTemplate: Раттл є одним з найстаріших звукових іграшок. У {country}, {civ} обережні витримали довгі ущільнені насіння або гальки в сурпурі, глині, корзині, або дереві, щоб нагородити дитяче захоплення і ритм. Раттл - як сенсорна іграшка, так і в деяких місцях, захисний чарівний звук.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Порожня кришка з насінням, гальками, або дзвіночками

whistle_toy.title: Клей або дерево з білим іграшкам
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Невеликі скоси — птахоподібна глина, різьблена дерево, reed—приваблива на ринках і археологічних шарів, пов'язаних з життям ЗЗЦУ в ЗЗКОУНТРИЗ. Діти використовують їх як голосно-розширювальні іграшки; деякі подвійні як фестивальні шумотворці. Звукова гра вчить дихання і грайливо. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Тварина тягнуть
pull_toy.descTemplate: Виготовлені тварини та висувні фігури задокументовані з класичної давнинини через сільські лісопродукти в ЗЗКОУНТРИЗ. {civ} артисани формують коні, птахи або оксен, які навчають ходьбою малюків про тягову і супутню рух. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: Іграшка bow або dart ігровий набір
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Шпакльовані мисливські іграшки дозволяють дітям в {country} переробляти навички, відсвяткували {civ} дорослих—архія, списання-чорнильні альтанки, або попадання мети — у безпечних матеріалах. Цільові цілі на соломі, дереві, або складені кола перетворюють бойову техніку на забиту гру.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: Кишенькові майстерності камені
jacks_local.descTemplate: За межами сімейства спільних кункул, {country} має локальні кам'яні та дослідні послідовники, що формовані дитячим {civ} - диференційні кидки, штани та складні сходи на принципі ж пікапу, записані тут як регіональний запис практики, коли штани та послідовності локально виділяються.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Історія лотів / малювання лотів гри
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Розлив лотів для витків, кормів або сюжетних підказок з'являється в ЗППІВЗ зібрання в ЗЗКУНТРИЗ. Якщо бамбукові палички, knucklebones, або розфарбовані діси, шанс вибрати, хто говорить, танці, або відповіді - соціальна іграшка на краю divination і партійної гри. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Тіні фігури гра
shadow_play.descTemplate: Тінь гра - руки тварин або шкіряні цуценята - затримали ночі в ЗЗКУНЦРИЗІЗУ в історії ЗЗЦВЗ. Світло і силует перетворюють жест в театр. Деякі регіони підняли це в формальне лялькове мистецтво; дитячі ручні тіні залишаються у формі іграшок. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Місцевий кошеня
kite_local.descTemplate: У той час як кокс літаючий є однією глобальною родиною, {country}'s {civ} були розроблені відмінні форми, паперу, бліх та фестивальних творах. Цей запис висвітлює, що місцева традиція ремесла як регіональна практика кошеня під широким кайтом.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Місцева тканина лялька
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: М'які ляльки, одягнені в локальних текстильних візерунках, з'являються по {civ} домогосподарствам в {country}. Вишивка, одяг та зачіски мініатурізовані дорослі сукні. Обережна гра вчить соціальних ролей; техніка ремесел між поколіннями.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Сушені тканини або приховувати м'яч
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Перед промисловою гумкою, {civ} громадами в ЗЗКУНТРИЗ, фаршировані і зшиті кульки з ховати, тканини або рослинної клітковини. Кетч, кліщ і кругові ігри виросли навколо цих об'єктів. Ми можемо самі зателефонувати одержувачу. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.
req: Сушені тканини, долоню, або приховувати м'яч

top_local.title: Місцевий шпинат верхнього ремесла
top_local.descTemplate: Кращі ігри є стародавнім і глобальним; це запис записів {country}'s {civ} різьблення стилів, наконечникові матеріали та конкурс етикету як відмінна практика ремесел в рамках цієї спільної фізики іграшка.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Місцеві фігури
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} струнких фігур, пов'язаних з {country}, носять локальні імена, тварини та міфи навіть при відкриттів нагадують кішка в іншому місці. Картини переносні діаграми історії та ручної пам'яті.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Народна рада (локальна)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: На багатьох землях з’являються перехресні дошки та доріжки. У {country} {civ} використовуються оболонки, палички, або кокклебони для гонщиків будинку — купа для пачі-подібних структур, але з локальними формами та безпечними просторовими митними мовами, записаними як обласна народна рада.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Місцеве життєздатне посівне
sowing_local.descTemplate: Де посівні ігри приймали корінь в ЗЗОУНТРИЗ, дошки ЗЦВЗ показують відмінні кількості чашок, правила реле та форми деревини. Вони відносяться до сімейства манка, але заслуговують на регіональні записи при геометрії дошки і захоплюють митне оформлення. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Кубок дошки або цици на землі

jump_rope.title: Скіппинг трос Ігри
jump_rope.descTemplate: Скіппінг і стрибки з хіями тривають у шкільних двориках ЗЗОУНТРИЗ та вулицях у дитячій культурі ЗЦКІВЗ. Соло швидкості і групові довгострокові ігри діляться розкручуванням ритму; штани локалізують іграшка. ({country}, {civ})
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: Blind чоловічий тег / виклик ігри
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Зібрані пошуки ігор — цехно-доджові варіанти — з'являються по сторонам ЗЦУ та дитячим зборам в ЗЗКОУНТРИЗ. Звуки, симпатія і емпатія для сліпих гравців структура веселощів. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Народна боротьба для молоді
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Молодіжні ігри, які готують для дорослих народних стилів відсвяткували {civ} громади {country}. Грати версії підкреслюють безпечні кисті, межі кола та сміхання над травмою — спорт як соціальна іграшка.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Пісня пам'яті / видалення штан
memory_song.descTemplate: Використовуються штани і пісні пам'яті — до «хто залишається» кругові ігри — знайдуть іграшки ритму і увагу в {civ} усній культурі в {country}. Помилкові слова або пропущені удари усувають гравців до одного залишається.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Підставки або баланси
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Штити з'являються як фестивальні інструменти та дитячі балансові іграшки в {country}. {civ} вирощує ходи на бамбук, дерево або перероблені банки. Перегони та хитрощі перетворюються в гру.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: Леф або барк човни
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Мініатюрні катерні забіги з використанням листя, кора, або карнизи радують дітей біля води в ЗЗОУНТРИЗ. {civ} гра перетворює струми до треків і ремесел в інженерних експериментах. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: Листя, кора, або пробка для корпусів

snow_or_sand.title: Пісок / сніг фігури гра
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Скульптура тимчасових фігур в піску або снігу - це елементарна будівельна гра, де переходять {civ} ландшафти в {country}. Замки, тварини, а також представницькі форми з'являються і еродом—архітектура як ефемерна іграшка.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Табличка лизати футбол / паперовий футбол
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick ігри, які імітують футбол / soccer на стільниці поширення через школи в {country}, нанесені на старше пальцево-лишкове звичаї в дитинстві {civ}. Цілі є книги або намальовані листи; турніри можуть бути запеклими.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Місцевий глухий обмін
riddle_local.descTemplate: Біржі {country} зберігають {civ} метафор, екологія та гумор. Позування та розв’язання під час тиску – це розумова іграшка, яка не вимагає виробництва обладнання.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Фестивальний шумокер іграшка
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Фестивальні шумотворці — ракетети, клаппери, живітниці — долучайтеся до {civ} публічних обрядів в {country}. Об'єм і ритм позначки часу календаря; деякі іграшки сезонні і зберігаються після того, як ритуальний передач.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, паличка дзвінка, clapper або барабан іграшка

puzzle_knot.title: Корд і вузлик головоломки іграшка
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Незаперечні головоломки шнура, кільця, і дерево з'являються як ринкові іграшки і ковальні кучеряві навколо ЗЗОУНТРИЗ. Гравці {civ} навчаються топології за допомогою сенсорного відео-випуску кільця без загартування, після чого переобрано. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Мініатюрний побутовий ігровий набір
mini_house.descTemplate: Крихітні побутові інструменти — це сковорідки, ткані килими, лялькові меблі— підтримка роль-плей для дорослого домашнього життя в дитячих садочках ЗППІВЗ у ЗЗКОУНТРИЗі. Археологія і етнографія як знайти ці іграшки для навчання. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: کودک rattle
rattle.descTemplate: Rattles are among the oldest sound toys. In {country}, {civ} caregivers have long sealed seeds or pebbles in gourd, clay, basketry, or wood to reward infant grasping and rhythm. The rattle is both sensory toy and, in some places, a protective charm sound.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: هالو با دانه ها، سنگر ها یا زنگ ها

whistle_toy.title: کلی یا چوب سوت
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Small whistles—bird-shaped clay, carved wood, reed—appear in markets and archaeological layers tied to {civ} life in {country}. Children use them as voice-amplifying toys; some double as festival noisemakers. Sound play teaches breath and pitch playfully.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: حیوانات اسباب بازی
pull_toy.descTemplate: Wheeled animals and pull-along figures are documented from classical antiquity through village woodcrafts in {country}. {civ} artisans shape horses, birds, or oxen that teach walking toddlers about traction and companionship in motion.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: شکل حیوانی چرخ دار یا کشویی

mini_weapons_toy.title: اسباب بازی یا بازی دار
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Scaled hunting toys let children in {country} rehearse skills celebrated by {civ} adults—archery, spear-thorn darts, or blowpipe aim—using safer materials. Targets on straw, wood, or drawn circles turn martial technique into scored play.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: قدرت نرم یا کم قدرت برای کمان/دارتس

jacks_local.title: سنگ های مهارت جیب
jacks_local.descTemplate: Beyond the shared knucklebones family, {country} has local stone-and-seed skill sequences shaped by {civ} childhood—different throws, chants, and difficulty ladders on the same pickup principle, recorded here as a regional practice entry when chants and sequences are locally distinct.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: خلاصه داستان : طراحی بازی های زیادی
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Casting lots for turns, forfeits, or story prompts appears in {civ} gatherings in {country}. Whether bamboo sticks, knucklebones, or painted dice, chance chooses who speaks, dances, or answers—a social toy at the edge of divination and party game.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.
req: چوب های مارک شده، زیاد یا تاس

shadow_play.title: بازی Shadow
shadow_play.descTemplate: Shadow play—hand animals or leather puppets—has entertained nights in {country} within {civ} storytelling. Light and silhouette turn gesture into theater. Some regions elevated this into formal puppet arts; children's hand shadows remain the toy form.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.
req: دست ها یا عروسک های کوتاه

kite_local.title: هتل های محلی
kite_local.descTemplate: While kite flying is one global family, {country}'s {civ} makers developed distinctive shapes, papers, bridles, and festival uses. This entry highlights that local craft tradition as a regional kite practice under the wider kite sky.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: عروسک لباس محلی
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Soft dolls dressed in local textile patterns appear across {civ} households in {country}. Embroidery, wrap clothing, and hairstyles miniaturize adult dress. Caregiving play teaches social roles; craft techniques pass between generations.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: پارچه یا توپ پنهان
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Before industrial rubber, {civ} communities in {country} stuffed and sewed balls from hide, cloth, or plant fiber. Catch, kick, and circle games grew around these objects. The ball's make is as cultural as the rules.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: محلی در حال چرخش بالا
top_local.descTemplate: Top play is ancient and global; this entry records {country}'s {civ} carving styles, tip materials, and contest etiquette as a distinct craft-and-play practice within that shared physics toy.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: چهره های رشته محلی
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} string figures linked to {country} carry local names, animals, and myths even when openings resemble cat's cradle elsewhere. The figures are portable diagrams of story and hand memory.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.
req: دانلود موسیقی متن فیلم Cord or Sinew

board_race_folk.title: هیئت مدیره مسابقه عمومی (local)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Cross-and-circle and path race boards appear in many lands. In {country}, {civ} players used shells, sticks, or knucklebones to race markers home—cousins to pachisi-like structures but with local track shapes and safe-space customs recorded as a regional folk race board.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: دانه های محلی و دانه ها
sowing_local.descTemplate: Where sowing games took root in {country}, {civ} boards show distinctive cup counts, relay rules, and wood shapes. They belong to the mancala family yet deserve regional entries when board geometry and capture customs are locally standardized.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: بازی های پرش طناب
jump_rope.descTemplate: Skipping and jump-rope rhymes thrive in {country}'s schoolyards and streets within {civ} childhood culture. Solo speed steps and group long-rope games share the bouncing rhythm; chants localize the toy.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: برچسب مرد نابینا / بازی های تماس
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Blindfolded seeking games—call-and-dodge variants—appear across {civ} parties and children's gatherings in {country}. Sound, stillness, and empathy for the blinded player structure the fun.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: کشتی های مردمی برای جوانان بازی می کنند
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Youth wrestling games prepare for adult folk styles celebrated by {civ} communities in {country}. Play versions emphasize safe throws, circle boundaries, and laughter over injury—sport as social toy.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: آهنگ حافظه / حذف شعار
memory_song.descTemplate: Elimination chants and memory songs—akin to 'who remains' circle games—are toys of rhythm and attention in {civ} oral culture in {country}. Wrong words or missed beats eliminate players until one remains.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: قدرت ها یا قطب های تعادل
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts appear as festival tools and children's balance toys in {country}. {civ} makers raise walkers on bamboo, wood, or recycled cans. Racing and trick-stepping turn elevation into play.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: دانلود موسیقی متن فیلم Pair of stilts یا Tin-can stilts

leaf_boat.title: پیاده روی قایق
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Miniature boat races using leaves, bark, or corncobs delight children near water in {country}. {civ} play turns currents into tracks and craft into engineering experiments.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: برگ، پوست، یا cork برای بدنه ها

snow_or_sand.title: بازی Sand / Snow
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Sculpting temporary figures in sand or snow is elemental construction play wherever {civ} landscapes in {country} provide the medium. Castles, animals, and ancestral forms appear and erode—architecture as ephemeral toy.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
