Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.
req: دست ها یا قالب های ساده

knuckle_football.title: میز فوتبال / فوتبال کاغذی
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick games that simulate football/soccer on a tabletop spread through schools in {country}, layered onto older finger-flicking toy habits in {civ} childhood. Goals are books or drawn posts; tournaments can be fierce.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: تبادل محلی
riddle_local.descTemplate: Riddle exchanges in {country} preserve {civ} metaphor, ecology, and humor. Posing and solving under time pressure is a mind toy requiring no manufactured equipment.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: نام انگلیسی: Voicemaker Toy
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Festival noisemakers—ratchets, clappers, bell-sticks—let children join {civ} public rites in {country}. Volume and rhythm mark calendar time; some toys are seasonal and stored afterward like ritual gear.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.

puzzle_knot.title: دانلود بازی Cord & node Puzzle Toy
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: Disentanglement puzzles of cord, rings, and wood appear as market toys and blacksmith curiosities around {country}. {civ} players learn topology by touch—release a ring without forcing, then reassemble.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.
req: کورد، حلقه ها یا پازل سیم

mini_house.title: بازی خانگی Miniature
mini_house.descTemplate: Tiny household tools—clay pans, woven mats, doll furniture—support role-play of adult domestic life in {civ} childhoods in {country}. Archaeology and ethnography both find these teaching toys.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.
req: گلدان های مینیاتوری، تشک ها یا عروسک ها

rattle.title: র‍্যাটল
rattle.descTemplate: র‍্যাটলগুলো সবথেকে পুরনো খেলনার মধ্যে অন্যতম। জিজেডজেডজেড-এ, ZZCIZZeeegeries লম্বা সময় ধরে কাঠ বা পাথরের টুকরো বা পাথরের টুকরো দিয়ে ঢেকে রেখেছে। র‍্যাটল হচ্ছে সেন্সর খেলনা আর কিছু জায়গায়, যেটা নিরাপদ রুপ।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: বীজ, নুড়ি অথবা বেলের সাথে কোমল

whistle_toy.title: কাঠ বা কাঠের হুইসেল
whistle_toy.descTemplate: ছোট হুইসেল-পাখিgedit, কাঠ দিয়ে তৈরি করা, কাঠের টুকরো তৈরি করা- বাজারে গিয়ে দেখা যায় এবং জেজেডইজিজেড জীবনে বাঁধা থাকে। শিশুরা তাদের কণ্ঠস্বরকে সুন্দর খেলনা হিসেবে ব্যবহার করে; আবার কেউ কেউ উৎসবের নির্মাতা। শব্দ শ্বাস-প্রশ্বাস এবং রানার খেলা।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: এনিমেলি টান
pull_toy.descTemplate: জেজেডজেডজ-এ অবস্থিত গ্রামের কাঠ-খড়ের মাধ্যমে চালিত প্রাণী এবং টেনে তোলা হয়েছে। এ ছাড়া, তারা তাদের সন্তানদের সঙ্গে বাইবেল অধ্যয়ন করতেও সাহায্য করে ।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: চাকা চালিত বা ঘন সবুজ পশু সংখ্যা

mini_weapons_toy.title: তীর চিহ্নযুক্ত হোক বা না হোক, খেলা আরম্ভ করো
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: আকার ধারণ করা খেলনা শিশুদের জিজেডজেডজেডজেডজেড-এর অনুশীলনে দক্ষতা অর্জন করতে দেওয়া হয়েছে। মাটি, কাঠ, অথবা বৃত্তে আঁকা সামরিক কৌশলের খেলা।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: পকেট দক্ষতা পাথর
jacks_local.descTemplate: শেয়ারকৃত ডানজিবোন পরিবার ছাড়াও জেজেডকিউজেডের স্থানীয় পাথর আর বীজের দক্ষতা ক্রম রয়েছে যা জিজেডজেড শৈশবে তৈরী হয়েছে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: গল্প-হের ধরন/হার্ড খেলা
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: এর জন্য প্রচুর ত্যাগ করা, অথবা ZZZIZZ র সমাবেশ থেকে দেখা যায়। বাঁশের লাঠি, বা পাশা আঁকা হোক, কে কথা বলে, নাচে, নাচ বা উত্তর দেবে- এমন এক সমাজ যা মন্ত্রিণী ও দলের খেলায় অংশ নেবে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: ছায়া নির্দেশক খেলা
shadow_play.descTemplate: ছায়া বাজানো-হাতী প্রাণী বা চামড়ার পুতুল - জেডজেডজিআইজিজেডের মধ্যে রাতে আনন্দ পেয়েছে। লাইট আর স্লেট থিয়েটারে পরিণত হয়। কিছু অঞ্চল এটাকে আনুষ্ঠানিক পুতুল শিল্পে উচ্চীকৃত করেছে; শিশুদের হাতে ছায়া আছে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: স্থানীয় কিট কারিগর
kite_local.descTemplate: উড়ন্ত উড়ন্ত পাখি হচ্ছে বিশ্বব্যাপী একটি পরিবার, ZZCZZZ এর ZZIZ কারিগররা আলাদা আকৃতি, কাগজ, হট্টগোল আর উৎসবের আয়োজন করেছে। এই এন্ট্রিতে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে যে স্থানীয় কলা ঐতিহ্যটি বিশাল আকারের কিট আকাশের সাথে আঞ্চলিক কিট চর্চার একটি ঐতিহ্য।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: স্থানীয় কাপড়ের পুতুল
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: {civ} পরিবারের সবাই মিলে পুতুল বানানো হয়েছে। আপনি কীভাবে উত্তর দেবেন? যত্ন নেওয়া সামাজিক ভূমিকার শিক্ষা দেয়; প্রজন্মের পর প্রজন্ম ধরে প্রযুক্তিগত প্রযুক্তি পাস।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: ♪ গা ঢাকা কাপড় বা লুকানো ♪
ball_sewn.descTemplate: রবার, ZZZIZZZ সম্প্রদায়ের সামনে ZZIZZZZLasked এবং লুকানো, কাপড়, কাপড় অথবা ফাইবার দিয়ে বল বানানো হয়েছে। ধর, কিক এবং বৃত্ত এই বস্তুগুলোর মাঝে বেড়ে গেছে। বলটা সাংস্কৃতিক নিয়ম হিসেবে তৈরি।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: স্থানীয় দড়ির স্তর
top_local.descTemplate: উপরের নাটকটি প্রাচীন এবং বিশ্বব্যাপী; এই এন্ট্রিটি জেজেডজেডজেডজেডজ'র জZZZZ স্টাইল, বকশিশ Nuku, এবং প্রতিযোগিতাকে ফিজিক্সের সাথে ভাগ করে নিয়েছে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: স্থানীয় পংক্তি সংখ্যা
string_local.descTemplate: ZZIVZZZ এর চরিত্রের মধ্যে রয়েছে ZZCCUNZZZ স্থানীয় নাম, প্রাণী, এবং গল্প, এমনকি যখন অন্য কোথাও বিড়ালের মাটির মত আঁকা হয়। চিত্রগুলো হলো বহনযোগ্য চিত্র এবং হাতের স্মৃতি।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: রেস বোর্ড (স্থানীয়)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: ক্রস-এবং জাহাজ অনেক দেশে দেখা যায়। জেজেডজেডজেড-এ জেজেডআইভিজেড-এর খেলোয়াড়রা গোলা, লাঠি, লাঠি অথবা নাককাটা হাড় ব্যবহার করে থাকে, যা কিনা বর্ণগৃহের মত কাঠামোর জন্য প্রযোজ্য, কিন্তু স্থানীয় ভাবে চিহ্নিত করা হয় এবং স্থানীয় ভাবে স্থানীয় ভাবে চিহ্নিত করা হয়।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.
req: ট্র্যাক বোর্ড অথবা কাপড় ট্র্যাক করুন

sowing_local.title: স্থানীয় গর্ত এবং বীজ বপন
sowing_local.descTemplate: জিজেডজেডজেডজেড, জেজেডআইভিজেড বোর্ড বোর্ডগুলো নির্দিষ্ট কাপের নিয়ম, রিলে এবং কাঠের আকৃতি নির্ধারণ করে। তারা মাক্সিরা পরিবারের সদস্য, যারা এখনো আঞ্চলিক এন্ট্রির যোগ্য, যখন বোর্ড জ্যামিতি এবং ধারণ প্রথা স্থানীয় ভাবে পালন করা হয়।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: রশির খেলা উপেক্ষা করুন
jump_rope.descTemplate: ZZZZZZZ এর স্কুলের মোড় এবং রাস্তার মাঝে লাফ দিয়ে লাফ দিয়ে লাফ দিয়ে লাফ দেওয়া এবং লাফ-রো-রো-রো-রো-প্রজম আনন্দ বৃদ্ধি করা। সলোর গতি এবং দল দীর্ঘ সময় ধরে জুয়া খেলে থাকে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: অন্ধ ব্যক্তির ট্যাগ / %s
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: ব্লাইন্ড গেমের চেষ্টা করছে- কল- এন্ড এন্ড-ডোজেজেজেজেজ দল এবং শিশুদের সমাবেশ। শব্দ, সহানুভূতি এবং অন্ধ খেলোয়াড়কে নিয়ে মজা করার জন্য সহানুভূতি।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: তরুণ প্রজন্মের জন্য বন্ধুত্ব
wrestling_play.descTemplate: জেডজিআইভিজেড সম্প্রদায় দ্বারা আয়োজিত প্রাপ্তবয়স্কদের স্টাইলের জন্য তরুণ বক্সিং খেলা। খেলার সংস্করণগুলো নিরাপদ নিক্ষেপ, বৃত্তের সীমানা এবং হাসির উপর জনগনের সামাজিক হিসাবে পাঠানো।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Memory song / elimination chant
memory_song.descTemplate: ভাষাগত স্লোগান আর স্মৃতি গান- 'যারা এখনও বৃত্ত গেমসে আছে' - জেডজিআইজি রতিপালকজেজেডের গান আর দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণের মতো। ভুল শব্দ বা মিস করা খেলোয়াড়কে শেষ করে দেয় যতক্ষণ না কেউ বেঁচে থাকে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: গণনা করো
balance_stilts.descTemplate: স্টলটকে উৎসবের হাতিয়ার হিসেবে দেখা হয় এবং ZZZUNZZ এ শিশুদের ভারসাম্য খেলনা হিসেবে দেখা হয়। জ্যাকিভিজেডজ-এর কারিগররা বাঁশ, কাঠ বা রিসাইকেল বা রিসাইকেল ব্যবহার করে হাঁটতে থাকেন। রেগ আর কৌশলের মাধ্যমে খেলা শুরু হয়. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: লিফ বা বারিক বোট রেস
leaf_boat.descTemplate: ছোট ছোট নৌকাগুলো পাতা, বারক অথবা ভূট্টার মধ্যে দিয়ে বাচ্চাদের ZZONuzz এর কাছে জল দিয়ে আনন্দ করে । {civ}Z খেলতে গিয়ে বর্তমানে ট্র্যাকে পরিণত হয় এবং ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং পরীক্ষাতে দক্ষতা তৈরি করে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: sk, sck, fherd এর জন্য sk অথবা nk

snow_or_sand.title: স্যান্ড পয়েন্ট গেম
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: বালি বা বরফের অস্থায়ী পরিসংখ্যানকে জোড়ালো করা হচ্ছে এমন উপাদান, যা জেজেডজিআইজিজেড এলাকায় অবস্থিত। ক্যাসেল, প্রাণী, এবং পৈতৃক রূপ দেখা গেছে এবং ধ্বংস হয়ে গেছে-আততঙ্করীয়ত্বের প্রতীক হিসেবে।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: টেবিল কুইক ফুটবল / কাগজ ফুটবল ফুটবল
knuckle_football.descTemplate: দর্শকের খেলা, যা একটি টেবিলের উপর অবস্থিত ফুটবল/সো শ্রমিকদেরকে অনুকরণ করে। উদ্দেশ্য হচ্ছে বই বা স্কুইড পোস্ট; টুর্নামেন্টে প্রতিযোগিতা হবে ভয়ংকর।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: স্থানীয় ধাঁধা বিনিময়
riddle_local.descTemplate: ZZZZZZZZ রূপক সংরক্ষণ করা ZZIZZ, ইকোজিতত্ত্ব এবং রসিকতা। সময়ের চাপ কমতে থাকা আর সমাধান করা একটা মনের ব্যাপার যে কোন যন্ত্র উৎপাদন করতে হবে না।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: উৎসবের শব্দ নির্মাতা
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: সাউন্ড নির্মাতা-কার্তিকর, শিল্পী, বেল-স্টিক- বাচ্চারা জেজেডজেডজ-এর গণ উপাসনায় যোগ দিন। ভলিউম ও তালের ক্যালেন্ডারের সময়কে চিহ্নিত করে; কিছু খেলনা ঋতুর সঙ্গে যুক্ত থাকে এবং পরে প্রথার মতো ব্যবহার করা হয় ।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: রেস্তেট, বেল লাঠি, চিৎকারকারী, অথবা ড্রাম বাজানো

puzzle_knot.title: করবা এবং ধাঁধার মধ্যে ধাঁধা
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: কিন্তু, এগুলো ছিল সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় । জেজিসিআইভিজেডজি খেলোয়াড়দের স্পর্শের মাধ্যমে সর্বোচ্চ নম্বর অর্জন করতে হয়।. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: ছোট আকৃতির খেলা
mini_house.descTemplate: টাইনি হাউজিং যন্ত্র- প্যানস, পুতুলের আসবাবপত্র, পুতুলের তৈরি- জেডজিআইভিজেড-এর শিশু অবস্থায় প্রাপ্তবয়স্কদের ভূমিকাকে সমর্থন করা। কা. পূ. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Mtoto wa Rottle
rattle.descTemplate: Sauti ni miongoni mwa sauti za kale zaidi. Katika ZZCOUNTRY, {civ} walezi kwa muda mrefu muhuri mbegu au pebbles katika gourd, udongo, vikapu, au kuni kwa malipo ya mtoto kufahamu na rhythm. Rattle ni toy ya hisia na, katika baadhi ya maeneo, sauti ya charm ya kinga. ({country}, {civ})
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.
req: Hollow rattle with seeds, pebbles, or bells

whistle_toy.title: Toy au Toy
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Vivumishi vidogo - udongo wa umbo la ndege, mbao za kuchonga, zimeonekana tena katika masoko na tabaka za akiolojia zilizofungwa kwa maisha ya {civ} katika {country}. Watoto hutumia kama toys za kuongeza sauti; baadhi ya mara mbili kama kelele za tamasha. Sauti kucheza kufundisha pumzi na lami playfully.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Wanyama wa kipenzi
pull_toy.descTemplate: Wanyama Wheeled na pull-along takwimu ni kumbukumbu kutoka zamani classical kupitia vijiji woodcrafts katika {country}. {civ} artisans sura farasi, ndege, au ng'ombe kwamba kufundisha kutembea toddlers kuhusu traction na ushirikiano katika mwendo.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.
req: Jinsi ya kupanda au kupanda mimea ya wanyama

mini_weapons_toy.title: Toy upinde au dart kucheza kuweka
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Vifaa vya uwindaji vilivyopimwa vinaruhusu watoto katika ujuzi wa {country} rehearse unaoadhimishwa na watu wazima wa {civ} -archery, mishale ya miiba, au lengo la blowpipe - kwa kutumia vifaa salama. Malengo juu ya majani, kuni, au miduara inayotolewa kugeuka martial mbinu katika kucheza alifunga.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.
req: Nguvu ya chini au ya chini ya toy bow/darts

jacks_local.title: Vifaa vya mikono
jacks_local.descTemplate: Zaidi ya familia ya knucklebones iliyoshirikiwa, {country} ina mlolongo wa ujuzi wa ndani wa mawe na ulioundwa na utoto wa {civ} - kutupa tofauti, nyimbo, na ngazi za ugumu kwenye kanuni hiyo ya pickup, iliyorekodiwa hapa kama kuingia kwa mazoezi ya kikanda wakati nyimbo na mlolongo ni tofauti nchini.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Hadithi nyingi / kuchora mchezo
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Kupiga kura kwa zamu, kupoteza, au hadithi ya kuchochea inaonekana katika mikutano ya {civ} katika {country}. Ikiwa fimbo za mianzi, knucklebones, au dice iliyochorwa, nafasi huchagua ambaye anaongea, kucheza, au majibu - toy ya kijamii kwa makali ya ubashiri na mchezo wa chama.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Takwimu za mchezo
shadow_play.descTemplate: Kivuli kucheza-mkono wanyama au vikaragosi ngozi-amewakaribisha usiku katika {country} ndani ya hadithi ya {civ}. Mwanga na silhouette hugeuka ishara katika ukumbi wa michezo. Baadhi ya mikoa iliinua hii katika sanaa rasmi za puppet; vivuli vya mkono wa watoto vinabaki fomu ya toy.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Nyumba ya Sanaa
kite_local.descTemplate: Wakati kuruka kite ni familia moja ya kimataifa, {country} ya {civ} ya watengenezaji maendeleo maumbo tofauti, karatasi, bridles, na matumizi ya tamasha. Kuingia hii inaonyesha kwamba utamaduni wa ufundi wa ndani kama mazoezi ya kite ya kikanda chini ya anga pana ya kite.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Mavazi ya Doll
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: dolls laini wamevaa katika mwelekeo wa nguo za ndani kuonekana katika kaya za {civ} katika {country}. Embroidery, mavazi ya kufunika, na hairstyles hupunguza mavazi ya watu wazima. Kujali kucheza kunafundisha majukumu ya kijamii; mbinu za hila hupita kati ya vizazi.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Kuvaa nguo au kuficha mpira
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Kabla ya mpira wa viwanda, jamii za {civ} katika {country} zimefunikwa na mipira ya kushona kutoka kwa ngozi, nguo, au fiber ya kupanda. Catch, kick, na michezo ya mzunguko ilikua karibu vitu hivi. Mpira ni kama utamaduni kama sheria.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: Home › Mafunzo › Top Craft
top_local.descTemplate: Juu ya kucheza ni ya zamani na ya kimataifa; hii rekodi ya kuingia {country} {civ} mitindo ya carving, vifaa vya ncha, na mashindano etiquette kama mazoezi tofauti ya ufundi na kucheza ndani ya toy hiyo ya fizikia iliyoshirikiwa.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Takwimu za Mitaa
string_local.descTemplate: {civ} takwimu kamba wanaohusishwa na {country} kubeba majina ya mitaa, wanyama, na hadithi hata wakati ufunguzi inafanana utoto wa paka mahali pengine. Takwimu ni michoro ya portable ya hadithi na kumbukumbu ya mkono.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Bodi ya mbio za watu (local)
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Mzunguko na mzunguko wa mbio za barabara huonekana katika nchi nyingi. Katika ZZCOUNTRY, wachezaji wa {civ} walitumia shells, fimbo, au knucklebones kwa alama za mbio nyumbani-cousins kwa miundo kama pachisi lakini kwa maumbo ya kufuatilia ya ndani na desturi za mahali salama zilizorekodiwa kama bodi ya jamii ya kikanda. ({country}, {civ})
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Wilaya ya Mkuranga
sowing_local.descTemplate: Ambapo sowing michezo alichukua mizizi katika {country}, {civ} bodi kuonyesha tofauti kikombe hesabu, sheria relay, na maumbo ya mbao. Wao ni wa familia ya mancala lakini wanastahili maingilio ya kikanda wakati geometry ya bodi na mila ya kukamata ni kawaida.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.
req: Kombe la Dunia au Kombe la Dunia

jump_rope.title: Michezo ya Skiing
jump_rope.descTemplate: Skipping na kuruka-rope rhymes kustawi katika shule ya {country} na mitaa ndani ya utamaduni wa utoto wa {civ}. Solo hatua kasi na kundi la muda mrefu-rope michezo kushiriki rhythm bouncing; nyimbo localize toy.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.
req: Rope ya hemp, plastiki au mzabibu

blindfold_tag.title: Mbadala majina ya mtu / wito michezo
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Blindfolded kutafuta michezo-call-na-dodge variants-kuonekana katika vyama vya {civ} na mikutano ya watoto katika {country}. Sauti, utulivu, na huruma kwa mchezaji kipofu muundo furaha.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Michezo kwa ajili ya vijana
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Vijana mieleka michezo kujiandaa kwa ajili ya watu wazima mitindo sherehe na jamii {civ} katika {country}. Matoleo ya kucheza yanasisitiza kutupa salama, mipaka ya mzunguko, na kicheko juu ya kuumia-michezo kama toy ya kijamii.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Wimbo wa kumbukumbu / download
memory_song.descTemplate: Kuondoa nyimbo na nyimbo za kumbukumbu - sawa na 'ambaye bado' michezo ya mzunguko - ni toys ya rhythm na tahadhari katika utamaduni wa mdomo wa {civ} katika {country}. Maneno mabaya au kushindwa hupunguza wachezaji mpaka mmoja abaki.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Kuweka mipaka au kuweka mipaka
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Stilts kuonekana kama vifaa vya tamasha na toys usawa wa watoto katika {country}. Waumbaji wa {civ} wanainua walkers kwenye mianzi, kuni, au makopo yaliyorejeshwa. Racing na Trick-stepping kugeuka mwinuko katika kucheza.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.
req: Vipande vya vitunguu au tin-can stilts

leaf_boat.title: Mpira au mpira wa kikapu
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Jamii ndogo ya mashua kwa kutumia majani, gome, au corncobs furaha watoto karibu na maji katika {country}. {civ} kucheza zamu mikondo katika nyimbo na ufundi katika majaribio ya uhandisi.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.
req: majani, gome, au cork kwa hulls

snow_or_sand.title: Sand / snow takwimu kucheza
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Sculpting takwimu za muda mfupi katika mchanga au theluji ni ujenzi wa msingi kucheza popote {civ} mandhari katika {country} kutoa kati. Kasri, wanyama, na aina za mababu zinaonekana na kupotea-architecture kama toy ya ephemeral.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Mpira wa miguu / mpira wa karatasi
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Flick michezo kwamba simulate mpira wa miguu / soccer juu ya meza kuenea kupitia shule katika {country}, layered juu ya wakubwa kidole-flicking toy tabia katika {civ} utoto. Malengo ni vitabu au machapisho yaliyochorwa; mashindano yanaweza kuwa makali.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.
req: Coin, button, au mpira wa karatasi

riddle_local.title: Kubadilishana kwa sakafu
riddle_local.descTemplate: Kubadilishana kati katika {country} kuhifadhi sitiari ya {civ}, ikolojia, na ucheshi. Kupiga na kutatua chini ya shinikizo la muda ni toy ya akili ambayo haihitaji vifaa vya viwandani.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Michezo ya Kubahatisha Toy
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Tamasha noisemakers-ratchets, clappers, bell-sticks-let watoto kujiunga {civ} rites ya umma katika {country}. Volume na rhythm alama ya kalenda wakati; baadhi ya toys ni msimu na kuhifadhiwa baadaye kama gear ya ibada.
steps: Ask an adult when ratchets, clappers, or bell-sticks are welcome in the {civ} festival calendar of {country}.
Play short pulses that match the procession drum or sung phrase—typically two or four beats per measure.
Stop instantly when ceremony leaders raise a hand or the song falls silent.
Do not imitate restricted sacred instruments or mock prayer gestures with the toy.
Wipe the handle clean and store the noisemaker until the next public festival day.
req: Ratchet, bell stick, clapper, au ngoma toy

puzzle_knot.title: Kucheza mchezo Puzzle Toy
puzzle_knot.descTemplate: puzzles Disentanglement ya kamba, pete, na kuni kuonekana kama toys soko na weusi curiosities karibu {country}. Wachezaji wa {civ} wanajifunza topolojia kwa kugusa-kutoa pete bila kulazimisha, kisha reassemble.
steps: Study a cord-and-ring or wire puzzle sold or forged around {country}; note which loop is the piece you must free.
Move loops only through openings that already exist—do not bend metal or force wood.
Free the target ring or block by a legal path; {civ} market puzzles are solved when that piece separates cleanly.
Reassemble every loop to the exact starting state before claiming the solve.
Time your solve, then challenge a friend to beat that time with the same path.

mini_house.title: Nyumba ndogo ya kucheza
mini_house.descTemplate: Vifaa vya kaya vidogo - pans za pwani, mikufu ya kusuka, samani za doll - kusaidia jukumu la kucheza kwa maisha ya watu wazima wa ndani katika utoto wa {civ} katika {country}. Archaeology na ethnography wote wanapata toys hizi za kufundisha.
steps: Arrange miniature pots, mats, and dolls into a small hearth or room layout familiar in {country}.
Assign roles (cook, guest, child) to dolls or players before the scene starts.
Act out one cooking scene, one market or visiting scene, and one bedtime scene drawn from {civ} daily life.
Add one new prop each week (ladle, basket, or stool) and reuse it in the next story.
Pack all pieces into one box after play so the set stays complete.

rattle.title: Crepitaculum infantis
rattle.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Crepitaculum infantis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: In {country}, offer a sealed {civ} rattle (gourd, clay, wood, or basketry with seeds or pebbles) within the infant’s supervised reach.
Shake once slowly so the child hears a clear cause-and-effect sound, then pause for them to grasp.
Allow grasping, gentle shaking, and dropping onto a soft mat; block mouthing if the shell cracks or finishes flake.
Sing or speak a short {civ} lullaby or counting rhyme from {country} in time with three to five shakes.
After each session, check seams, plugs, and loose bits; retire the toy if seeds can spill.

whistle_toy.title: Fistula lusoria
whistle_toy.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Fistula lusoria» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Hold a clay, wood, or reed whistle made in the {civ} craft style of {country}; keep finger holes and the windway clear.
Blow a steady stream for two seconds to find one clear tone before trying short chirps.
Alternate three short calls and one long note; count successful clear tones aloud.
Play call-and-response with a partner: one player blows a rhythm from {country} street or festival play, the other copies it.
Wash or wipe the mouthpiece between players; do not share if anyone is ill.

pull_toy.title: Animalculum tractile
pull_toy.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Animalculum tractile» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Tie a short cord to the nose or yoke of a wheeled {civ} animal figure from {country}; leave enough slack for a toddler’s stride.
Walk five to ten steps on a clear floor so wheels or runners follow without tipping.
Make one gentle left turn and one right turn; stop if the axle binds or the cord jerks the toy airborne.
Narrate a short parade or market delivery story using animals familiar in {country} (horse, ox, bird, or camel as fits the figure).
Coil the cord after play and store the toy upright so wheels stay round.

mini_weapons_toy.title: Arcus lusorius
mini_weapons_toy.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Arcus lusorius» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Outdoors in {country}, set a straw, wood, or chalk target with a backstop; clear people and animals for at least five paces downrange.
Nock a soft arrow or load a foam/cork dart; keep the tip pointed at the ground until ready.
Use a calm {civ} stance—feet apart, eyes on the center ring—and release one shot at a time.
Score 3 points for the center, 2 for the middle ring, 1 for the outer; first to 15 points wins a round.
Never aim at people or animals; collect every projectile before the next turn.

jacks_local.title: Calculi sollertiae
jacks_local.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Calculi sollertiae» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Sit on flat ground in {country} with five small stones or seeds used in {civ} children’s pickup play.
Scatter all five lightly, then toss one skyward and pick up exactly one stone before catching the tossed stone.
On the next turns, pick up two, then three, then the last group of remaining stones in one sweep while the toss is aloft.
Drop or fail to catch ends your turn; the next player restarts at ones.
First player to finish the ones–twos–threes–fours ladder while saying a short {civ} count or chant from {country} wins.

story_dice_oral.title: Sortes narrativae
story_dice_oral.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Sortes narrativae» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Put three to six marked sticks, shells, or dice in a cup—marks can be colors or short {civ} prompt words used in {country}.
Shake once and cast onto a cloth; read the uppermost mark as this turn’s prompt.
The indicated player has thirty seconds to tell a short story, sing one verse, or perform a playful forfeit named by the mark.
Return all lots to the cup and pass clockwise until each player has had at least two turns.
Before starting, list which marks are playful only—never use sacred {civ} divination lots from {country} as party toys.

shadow_play.title: Lusus umbrarum
shadow_play.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Lusus umbrarum» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: In a dim room in {country}, place a lamp or candle so hands cast sharp shadows on a blank wall about one arm’s length away.
Form one animal or person with fingers; move slowly for three seconds so the outline stays readable.
Narrate a one-minute {civ} folk scene (market, animal chase, or hero greeting) while the shadow acts.
Optional: cut a cardboard figure, tape it to a stick, and replay the same scene with crisper edges.
End by letting each child invent one new creature and name it before the lamp is put out.

kite_local.title: Draco volatilis localis
kite_local.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Draco volatilis localis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Build or buy a paper or cloth kite in a shape used by {civ} makers in {country} (diamond, box, bird, or fighter flat).
Check that both bridle legs are equal and the spar joints are tight before you walk to the field.
Stand with the wind at your back in open ground; have a helper release the kite as you take three steps and feed five to ten meters of line.
Steer by tension: pull to climb, ease to dive; land by walking toward the kite while reeling.
Never fly near power lines, airports, or storms—common safety rules for festival kite days in {country}.

cloth_doll_local.title: Pupa textilis
cloth_doll_local.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Pupa textilis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Sew or tie a simple cloth body and stuff it firmly with fiber so the head and torso hold shape.
Dress the doll in miniature wraps, sash, or embroidered scraps that echo everyday {civ} clothing in {country}.
Act out at least three caregiving scenes: wake, feed, and put to sleep.
Repair tears with needle and thread as part of play rather than discarding the doll.
No points are scored—nurture play ends when the child packs the doll into a small basket or box used in {country} households.

ball_sewn.title: Pila consuta
ball_sewn.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Pila consuta» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Form a circle of four or more players in a clear yard in {country}; use one sewn cloth, palm-fiber, or hide ball.
Toss underhand to the neighbor on your right; {civ} circle play scores one point for each clean catch.
A drop removes that player from the circle (or gives the thrower one point if you play pairs).
When three players remain, speed up to a one-second hold before passing.
Last player in the circle wins; restart with everyone after one champion round.

top_local.title: Turbo localis
top_local.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Turbo localis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Wind a cord clockwise around a carved {civ} top from {country}, or ready a short whip cord if the tip is meant for whipping.
Plant your feet on hard earth or stone; pull the cord smooth and level so the tip bites and spins.
For whip tops, tap the shoulder of the top lightly to keep it upright for a timed spin.
In a contest, longest continuous spin wins; or play combat where the first top knocked flat loses.
Sand a dull tip and re-point it before the next match so launches stay true.

string_local.title: Figurae fili
string_local.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Figurae fili» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Make a loop of cord about the span of your outstretched arms so it fits both hands with slight slack.
Open on both thumbs and little fingers in the starting position taught for {civ} figures in {country}.
Pick, drop, and transfer strings until you hold one named figure (animal, tool, or star) for three seconds.
Say the figure’s {civ} name or a one-sentence story tied to {country} while holding the shape.
Teach that single figure to a partner before starting a second pattern.

board_race_folk.title: Tabula cursus popularis
board_race_folk.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Tabula cursus popularis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Seat 2–4 players at a path or cross-and-circle board used in {country}; each gets four markers in a starting nest.
Throw two casting sticks, four cowrie shells, or one die—whatever {civ} sets use—and total the pips or “mouth-up” shells.
Enter a marker only on a throw of the highest single result (for example 4 sticks or a 6); then advance that many spaces.
Landing on an opponent’s single marker sends it back to its nest; stacked markers are safe.
First player to move all four markers around the track and into the home column wins.

sowing_local.title: Satio localis
sowing_local.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Satio localis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Use a 2×6 board (twelve small pits plus one store per side) common in {civ} sowing play in {country}; place four seeds in each small pit.
On your turn, scoop every seed from one pit on your side and sow one seed into each following pit counterclockwise, including your store but skipping the opponent’s store.
If the last seed lands in your empty pit and the opposite pit holds seeds, capture those opposite seeds into your store.
If the last seed lands in your store, take another turn; otherwise play passes.
When one side’s pits are empty, the opponent puts remaining seeds in their store; most seeds in store wins.

jump_rope.title: Funis saltatorius
jump_rope.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Funis saltatorius» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: For solo play: hold both ends, swing the rope over your head, and jump once per pass; count consecutive jumps.
For group play: two turners swing a long rope; a jumper runs in, jumps five times, and runs out.
Add a short {civ} schoolyard chant from {country}; a missed jump or broken rhythm rotates the jumper to turner.
Try pepper (fast turns) or one double-under after you can clear twenty steady jumps.
Keep the rope away from roads, wet floors, and low branches.

blindfold_tag.title: Lusus oculis velatis
blindfold_tag.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Lusus oculis velatis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Clear toys and furniture from a bounded room or yard in {country}; mark walls or chalk lines as out-of-bounds.
Blindfold one seeker and spin them twice; sighted players must stay inside the bounds.
Sighted players may call a short {civ} nickname or clap once every five seconds so the seeker has sound cues.
The seeker tags by touch; the tagged player becomes the next seeker.
Stop the round immediately if anyone near stairs or hard edges; remove the blindfold before leaving the space.

wrestling_play.title: Lucta popularis
wrestling_play.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Lucta popularis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Mark a circle about three paces across on sand or soft ground used for youth bouts in {country}.
Forbid headlocks, joint twists, and strikes; wrestlers may grip belts, sashes, or shoulders as in {civ} play wrestling.
A referee starts each exchange; first to make the opponent’s knee or back touch outside or flat wins that exchange.
Best of three exchanges decides the bout; rest thirty seconds between exchanges.
Handshake or salute after the bout; the referee ends play at the first sign of pain.

memory_song.title: Carmen memoriae
memory_song.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Carmen memoriae» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Stand or sit in a circle so every player can see the leader’s hands.
The leader starts a {civ} elimination chant or clapping song known in {country}, with one word or beat per player.
Each player must say the next word or clap on the next beat without pausing more than one second.
A wrong word, late beat, or broken gesture eliminates that player, who steps back one pace.
Last remaining player wins and leads the next round’s chant.

balance_stilts.title: Grallae
balance_stilts.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Grallae» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Mount bamboo, wood, or tin-can stilts built in the {civ} style of {country} with a spotter holding your elbow.
Take ten small steps on level ground while looking forward, not down at the footrests.
Race a marked ten-meter line, or walk a chalk zigzag without a footrest touching the ground.
Dismount by stepping backward onto clear ground with the spotter ready.
Check cords, cans, and footrest bindings before every session; replace frayed ties.

leaf_boat.title: Naviculae foliorum
leaf_boat.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Naviculae foliorum» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Fold a broad leaf or carve a bark/cork hull that floats—materials children gather near water in {country}.
Mark a start and finish about two meters apart in a basin or gentle gutter current.
On a shared count of three in any {civ} counting words, release all boats together; no pushing after release.
First boat to touch the finish line wins the heat; run best of three heats.
Retrieve every leaf, twig, and cork; leave the water clear of trash.

snow_or_sand.title: Figurae arenae/nivis
snow_or_sand.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Figurae arenae/nivis» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: Gather moist sand or packable snow from a safe open patch in {country}—never dig undercut cliffs.
Pile a base, then carve one figure or fort wall with hands or a simple mold.
Optional contest: tallest free-standing tower in five minutes, or best likeness of an animal known in {civ} stories.
Photograph if you wish, then watch or gently collapse the build as part of play.
Stay off sacred dunes, marked ruins, and protected sites; fill holes you dig on public beaches.

knuckle_football.title: Pedifollis mensae
knuckle_football.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Pedifollis mensae» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: On a clear table in {country}, mark each goal with two small gaps about three finger-widths wide (books or tape posts).
Place a coin, button, or crumpled paper ball on the center line.
Players alternate one finger-flick; no covering the ball with a palm—common {civ} school-desk rule.
A goal scores when the ball fully crosses between the posts; play to five goals.
If the ball leaves the table, the opponent places it back one hand-span from the edge and flicks next.

riddle_local.title: Aenigmata localia
riddle_local.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Aenigmata localia» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
steps: One player poses a riddle drawn from {civ} oral tradition in {country} (animals, tools, weather, or food metaphors).
Others have one minute and up to three guesses.
A correct solver scores one point and poses the next riddle; if no one solves, the poser scores one point and chooses the next poser.
Optional playful forfeit for three wrong guesses: clap a rhythm or name five animals from ${c}.
First to five points wins the exchange.

ceremonial_toy.title: Crepitaculum festivum
ceremonial_toy.descTemplate: Ludicrum «Crepitaculum festivum» in {country} apud {civ} notum est. Forma culturalis traditionem localem ostendit; materiae et ritus differunt. Infantes per ludum artes sociales corporeasque discunt.
